scenes.name: 报警报失 · 公交上丢手机
scenes.setting: 早高峰公交上被人挤了一下，下车发现手机没了。

lines.en: Excuse me, I need to report a theft.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我要报案，东西被偷了。

lines.en: Where did it happen?
lines.zh: 在哪儿发生的？

lines.en: On the bus, about twenty minutes ago. My phone was taken.
lines.zh: 公交车上，大概二十分钟前。手机被偷了。

lines.en: Do you have the serial number?
lines.zh: 有序列号吗？

lines.en: It is in my email. I can find it.
lines.zh: 邮件里有。我能找出来。

lines.en: Good. We need it for the report.
lines.zh: 好。报案要用。

lines.en: Will I get a copy for my insurance?
lines.zh: 能给我一份副本走保险吗？

lines.en: Yes, with a case number. It takes about an hour.
lines.zh: 可以，带案件编号。大概一小时。

lines.en: Thank you. Should I block the phone first?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我要先停机吗？

lines.en: Do that now. Your provider can do it in minutes.
lines.zh: 现在就办。运营商几分钟就能停。

react.en: Use this one. I will look away from the password.

react.en: Come back within twenty-four hours and we will backdate it.

scenes.name: 轻微车祸处理 · 追尾
scenes.setting: 路口红灯，你停住了，后车没停住。

lines.en: Is anyone hurt?
lines.zh: 有人受伤吗？

lines.en: No, everyone is out of the cars. It was a rear-end shunt.
lines.zh: 没有，人都下车了。是追尾。

lines.en: Have you exchanged details yet?
lines.zh: 交换信息了吗？

lines.en: Not yet. I wanted to check with you first.
lines.zh: 还没有。我想先跟你确认一下。

lines.en: Name, insurer, policy number. And photos of both cars.
lines.zh: 姓名、保险公司、保单号。还有两辆车的照片。

lines.en: Should we move the cars off the lane?
lines.zh: 要把车挪开车道吗？

lines.en: Only if it is safe. Mark the positions first.
lines.zh: 安全的话可以。先标好位置。

lines.en: There is damage to both bumpers. Will insurance cover it?
lines.zh: 两个保险杠都坏了。保险能赔吗？

lines.en: That is for the insurers. Keep every photo you take.
lines.zh: 那是保险公司的事。照片都留着。

branch.task: 对方开始争责任，你要把话说清又不认账

prompt.en: You braked suddenly. That makes it your fault.
prompt.zh: 你突然刹车。这算你的责任。

say.en: I stopped for a red light. Let the insurers decide.
say.zh: 我是红灯停的车。让保险公司判断。

react.en: Fine. We will let them sort it out.

say.en: I am not going to argue here. Shall we just exchange details?
say.zh: 我不想在这儿争。先交换信息吧？

react.en: Agreed. Name and policy number.

scenes.name: 签证续签面谈 · 续学生签
scenes.setting: 你的学生签下月到期，约了面谈。

lines.en: What is the purpose of your visit?
lines.zh: 您此行的目的是什么？

lines.en: I am here to study. I am renewing my student visa.
lines.zh: 我来读书。在续学生签。

lines.en: How long have you been in the country?
lines.zh: 您在这儿待了多久？

lines.en: Two years. My course runs until next June.
lines.zh: 两年。课程到明年六月。

lines.en: Do you have proof of funds?
lines.zh: 有资金证明吗？

lines.en: I have three months of bank statements.
lines.zh: 我有三个月的银行流水。
lines.note: bank statement 是银行流水，签证材料里的固定说法。

lines.en: And where will you live?
lines.zh: 您住哪儿？

lines.en: Same flat. I have the tenancy agreement.
lines.zh: 还是那套房子。我有租约。

lines.en: Everything is in order. You will hear within two weeks.
lines.zh: 材料齐全。两周内会有结果。

branch.task: 签证官质疑你的资金，你要解释清楚

prompt.en: The balance drops below the threshold in the last month.
prompt.zh: 最后一个月余额低于门槛。

say.en: I paid the tuition in that month. Here is the receipt.
say.zh: 那个月我交了学费。这是收据。

react.en: That explains it. I will note it on the file.
react.zh: 这就说得通了。我在档案里注明。

say.en: My parents transferred the rest later. The statement shows it.
say.zh: 剩下的我父母后来转了。流水上有。

react.en: I see the transfer. Thank you.
react.zh: 我看到那笔转账了。谢谢。

scenes.name: 换本地驾照 · 换中国驾照
scenes.setting: 你搬来半年，国际驾照快到期了。

lines.en: I would like to exchange my foreign licence.
lines.zh: 我想换本地驾照。

lines.en: Which country is it from?
lines.zh: 哪国的？

lines.en: China. I have the original and a certified translation.
lines.zh: 中国。原件和认证翻译都有。

lines.en: You will also need a residence permit and a photo.
lines.zh: 还需要居留许可和一张照片。

lines.en: I have both. Do I need to take a test?
lines.zh: 都有。要考试吗？

lines.en: Not for your country. Just an eye test today.
lines.zh: 你们国家不用。今天只测视力。

lines.en: How long will the new licence take?
lines.zh: 新驾照要多久？

lines.en: Two weeks by post. You can drive on the old one until then.
lines.zh: 邮寄两周。这之前可以用旧驾照开车。

say.en: Can I come back this afternoon with it?
say.zh: 我下午带过来行吗？

react.en: We close at four. Come before three.

scenes.name: 补办银行卡 · 卡忘在取款机
scenes.setting: 你取完钱忘了拔卡，回头机器已经吞了。

lines.en: I need to report a lost bank card.
lines.zh: 我要挂失银行卡。

lines.en: When did you last use it?
lines.zh: 最后一次用是什么时候？

lines.en: This morning, at the station. I think I left it in the machine.
lines.zh: 今天早上，在车站。可能忘在机器里了。

lines.en: I will freeze it now. Do you want a replacement?
lines.zh: 我现在冻结。要补一张吗？

lines.en: Yes. Can it go to my home address?
lines.zh: 要。能寄到我家吗？

lines.en: It can, in five working days. There is a ten pound fee.
lines.zh: 可以，五个工作日。收十镑。

lines.en: That is fine. What about payments already taken?
lines.zh: 行。已经扣的款呢？

lines.en: Check them in the app. Anything you did not make, we refund.
lines.zh: 在 app 里核对。不是你刷的，我们退。

react.en: Then five working days, and I will text you.

scenes.name: 火警与疏散 · 楼道有烟
scenes.setting: 半夜警报响了，你穿拖鞋跑下楼。

lines.en: Fire service. What is the emergency?
lines.zh: 消防。什么情况？

lines.en: The alarm is going off and there is smoke in the hall.
lines.zh: 警报响了，走廊里有烟。

lines.en: Is everyone out of the building?
lines.zh: 楼里的人都出来了吗？

lines.en: I think so. We are on the pavement outside.
lines.zh: 应该都出来了。我们在外面人行道上。

lines.en: Do not go back in. Is your flat door closed?
lines.zh: 别回去。你家门关了吗？

lines.en: It is closed. The smoke seems to come from the ground floor.
lines.zh: 关了。烟好像是从一楼来的。

lines.en: We are two minutes away. Keep the entrance clear.
lines.zh: 我们两分钟到。把入口让出来。

lines.en: Understood. Should I knock on doors?
lines.zh: 明白。我要去敲门吗？

lines.en: Only if it is safe. Do not go above the smoke.
lines.zh: 安全的话可以。别往烟里走。

scenes.setting: 你下车十分钟后才想起来包还在座位下。

lines.en: I left a bag on the train this morning.
lines.zh: 我今早在火车上落了一个包。

lines.en: Which line, and what time?
lines.zh: 哪条线，几点？

lines.en: The eight fifteen to Reading. A black rucksack.
lines.zh: 八点十五去雷丁那班。黑色双肩包。

lines.en: Anything inside that identifies you?
lines.zh: 里面有能证明是你的东西吗？

lines.en: A laptop with a sticker, and my passport.
lines.zh: 一台贴了贴纸的电脑，还有护照。

lines.en: It may be at the lost property office. Give it a day.
lines.zh: 可能送到失物招领处了。等一天。

lines.en: Can I check online?
lines.zh: 能在网上查吗？

lines.en: Yes, and you can collect it with ID.
lines.zh: 能，带证件就能取。

branch.task: 查东西的方式有限制，你要换个途径

prompt.en: The online form only covers the last fourteen days.

say.zh: 我今早丢的，网上就够。

react.en: Then search by the train time, not the date.
react.zh: 那按车次时间搜，别按日期。

say.en: How do I check older items?
say.zh: 更早的东西怎么查？

react.en: Come to the office with ID and we will look in the back.
react.zh: 带证件来办公室，我们查库房。

scenes.name: 领事馆补办旅行证 · 护照丢失
scenes.setting: 你在国外旅行，护照和钱包一起丢了。

lines.en: How can I help?
lines.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: I lost my passport. I need an emergency travel document.
lines.zh: 我护照丢了。需要办紧急旅行证。

lines.en: Do you have a police report?
lines.zh: 有报警记录吗？

lines.en: Yes, from this morning.
lines.zh: 有，今天早上的。

lines.en: And a photo, plus proof of travel?
lines.zh: 还有照片和行程证明？

lines.en: I have my ticket for Friday.
lines.zh: 我有周五的机票。

lines.en: We can issue it in two days. Bring the fee in cash.
lines.zh: 两天能出。费用带现金。

lines.en: Will it be accepted at the border?
lines.zh: 边境会认吗？

lines.en: It is a one-way document. Show it with the police report.
lines.zh: 这是单程证件。和报警记录一起出示。

branch.task: 领事要确认你的身份，材料不全

prompt.en: The ticket alone does not prove who you are.
prompt.zh: 只有机票不能证明你是谁。

say.en: I have a photo of my passport on my phone.
say.zh: 我手机里有护照照片。

react.en: A photo helps, but we still need to verify with home.
react.zh: 照片有帮助，但还是要跟国内核实。

say.en: My employer can confirm my identity in writing.
say.zh: 公司可以出书面证明。

react.en: That would speed it up. Ask them to email us.
react.zh: 那会快一些。让他们发邮件给我们。

phrases.en: I need an emergency travel document.
Will it be accepted at the border?

scenes.name: 电梯里的寒暄 · 搬来一个月
scenes.setting: 你搬进新公寓一个月，今天在电梯里撞见了邻居。

lines.en: Morning! Nasty weather today, isn't it?
lines.zh: 早啊！今天天气真糟糕，是吧？
lines.note: 用反义疑问句开启闲聊是英语世界的通用做法，对方只需应一声。

lines.en: Tell me about it. I got soaked walking here.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛，我走过来全身都湿了。
lines.note: Tell me about it 不是「跟我说说」，而是强烈赞同＝「太对了」。

lines.en: Are you new to the building? I don't think we've met.
lines.zh: 你是新搬来的吧？我们好像没见过。

lines.en: I moved in last month, unit 302. I'm Wen.
lines.zh: 我上个月搬来的，302。我叫 Wen。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Wen. I'm Dan, 405. How's the flat working out?
lines.zh: 幸会，Wen。我是 Dan，405。房子住着怎么样？
lines.note: How's … working out 是问「结果如何／顺不顺利」，比 How is it 更自然。

lines.en: So far so good, apart from the noise from the street.
lines.zh: 到目前还好，就是街上有点吵。
lines.note: apart from＝除了。这个短语一出，抱怨也显得客气。

lines.en: Yeah, that takes some getting used to. I'm on the fourth floor if you ever need anything.
lines.zh: 是啊，这得适应一阵。有需要就上四楼找我。
lines.note: take some getting used to＝需要时间适应，固定搭配。

lines.en: That's kind of you. See you around!
lines.zh: 你人真好。回头见！

branch.task: 邻居提出一件具体的邀请，答应或婉拒，别让话掉在地上

prompt.en: If the noise gets too much, we've got a group chat about it. Want me to add you?
prompt.zh: 要是吵得受不了，我们有个群在说这事儿。要加你进来吗？

say.en: That'd be handy, thanks.
say.zh: 那挺方便，谢谢。

react.en: Great, I'll send you the link. I'm on the fourth floor too.
react.zh: 好，我把链接发你。我也住四楼。

say.en: Maybe later. I'm still settling in.
say.zh: 以后吧，我还在安顿。

react.en: No rush. I'm on the fourth floor if you change your mind.
react.zh: 不着急，改主意了就上四楼找我。

phrases.en: That takes some getting used to.

scenes.name: 理发店剪头 · 修剪一下
scenes.setting: 你头发长了两个月，只想修整齐，不想换发型。

lines.en: What are we doing today?
lines.zh: 今天怎么剪？

lines.en: Just a trim. Short on the sides, a bit off the top.
lines.zh: 就想修一下。两侧短一点，上面稍微剪短。
lines.note: trim 是「修剪」，不是「剪很多」；说 just a trim 理发师就不会下手太重。

lines.en: How short on the sides?
lines.zh: 两侧要多短？

lines.en: A number two, but not down to the skin.
lines.zh: 二号，但别推到露头皮。
lines.note: number two 是推剪的限位梳号数，数字越小越短。

lines.en: Got it. Shall I leave the front longer?
lines.zh: 明白。前面留长一点吗？

lines.en: Yes, just tidy it up.
lines.zh: 对，就修整齐。

lines.en: Do you want a wash as well?
lines.zh: 要洗一下吗？

lines.en: No, thanks. Just the cut.
lines.zh: 不用，就剪。

lines.en: That will be twenty-two.
lines.zh: 一共二十二。

branch.task: 工具出了问题，你要接受一个替代方案

react.en: Then I will go slow and even.

say.en: How much longer will it take?
say.zh: 要多花多久？

react.en: Fifteen minutes more, no extra charge.

scenes.name: 洗衣店送洗 · 洗加叠
scenes.setting: 你攒了两周的衣服，想一次性解决。

lines.en: Hi, how much for a wash and fold?
lines.zh: 你好，洗加叠多少钱？
lines.note: wash and fold 是洗衣店最便宜的服务：洗完叠好，不管熨。

lines.en: Twelve a load, ready tomorrow.
lines.zh: 一桶十二，明天取。

lines.en: Can I get it by tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚能取吗？

lines.en: Same day is eighteen, before six.
lines.zh: 当天取十八，六点前来拿。

lines.en: Do that. And this shirt needs dry cleaning.
lines.zh: 就当天。这件衬衫要干洗。

lines.en: That is six more. Any stains?
lines.zh: 再加六块。有污渍吗？

lines.en: One on the collar. I tried soap and it did not help.
lines.zh: 领子上有一块。我用肥皂试过，没用。

lines.en: We will have a go. It may not come out fully.
lines.zh: 我们试试。可能去不干净。

react.en: Understood. Same price, I am afraid.

phrases.en: How much for a wash and fold?

scenes.setting: 你给家里寄一箱东西，第一次用这边的邮局。

lines.en: I need to send this to China.
lines.zh: 我要把这个寄到中国。

lines.en: By air or surface?
lines.zh: 空运还是海运？

lines.en: Air, please. How long does it take?
lines.zh: 空运。要多久？

lines.en: Seven to ten days. Do you want tracking?
lines.zh: 七到十天。要追踪吗？

lines.en: Yes, the signed one.
lines.zh: 要，签收的那种。
lines.note: signed for 是要求签收的服务，丢件索赔时最有用。

lines.en: That is eighteen fifty. Fill in this form.
lines.zh: 十八块五。填这张表。

lines.en: Do I write the address in Chinese?
lines.zh: 地址写中文吗？

lines.en: Both languages, if you can. It helps at the other end.
lines.zh: 能写双语最好。对方那边好处理。

say.zh: 普通的就行，不值钱。

react.en: Then just the customs label.

scenes.name: 银行开户 · 新移民开户
scenes.setting: 你刚搬来一个月，房东提醒你尽快开本地账户。

lines.en: I would like to open an account.
lines.zh: 我想开个账户。

lines.en: Are you a resident here?
lines.zh: 您是本地居民吗？

lines.en: Yes, I moved here last month.
lines.zh: 是，我上个月搬来的。

lines.en: I need your ID and proof of address.
lines.zh: 需要您的证件和地址证明。

lines.en: I have a utility bill. Is that enough?
lines.zh: 我有水电费账单。够吗？

lines.en: It is, as long as it is less than three months old.
lines.zh: 够，只要是三个月内的。

lines.en: Good. And can I set up online banking today?
lines.zh: 好。今天能开通网银吗？

lines.en: You can. The card comes in five working days.
lines.zh: 可以。卡五个工作日内寄到。

lines.en: My card is missing. Can you freeze it?
lines.zh: 我的卡找不到了。能冻结吗？

lines.en: I can. Was it lost or stolen?
lines.zh: 可以。是丢了还是被偷了？

lines.en: Yes, I moved here last month.
lines.zh: 是，我上个月搬来的。

lines.en: I need your ID and proof of address.
lines.zh: 需要您的证件和地址证明。

lines.en: I have a utility bill. Is that enough?
lines.zh: 我有水电费账单。够吗？

lines.en: It is, as long as it is less than three months old.
lines.zh: 够，只要是三个月内的。

lines.en: Good. And can I set up online banking today?
lines.zh: 好。今天能开通网银吗？

lines.en: You can. The card comes in five working days.
lines.zh: 可以。卡五个工作日内寄到。

scenes.name: 药店买药 · 喉咙痛
scenes.setting: 你喉咙痛了三天，不想为这点事去诊所排队。

lines.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
lines.zh: 有治喉咙痛的吗？

lines.en: Is it dry, or with a cough?
lines.zh: 是干痛，还是带咳嗽？

lines.en: Dry, and it hurts when I swallow.
lines.zh: 干痛，咽东西就疼。

lines.en: These lozenges help. One every four hours.
lines.zh: 这种含片有用。四小时一片。

lines.en: Can I take them with ibuprofen?
lines.zh: 能和布洛芬一起吃吗？

lines.en: You can, but leave two hours between them.
lines.zh: 可以，但两种药隔两小时。
lines.note: leave two hours between 是「错开两小时」，用药安全的关键句。

lines.en: Got it. Do I need a prescription?
lines.zh: 明白。需要处方吗？

lines.en: Not for these. If it lasts more than a week, see a doctor.
lines.zh: 这些不用。要是超过一周，去看医生。

branch.task: 对方推荐替代品，你要判断能不能用

prompt.en: Those are out of stock. There is a generic, same ingredient, half the price.
prompt.zh: 那种没货了。有个仿制药，成分一样，半价。

say.en: Same strength?
say.zh: 剂量一样吗？

react.en: Same. Just a different box.

say.en: Will it work as fast?
say.zh: 起效一样快吗？

react.en: Identical, by law.

phrases.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
Can I take them with ibuprofen?

scenes.name: 找邻居说噪音 · 音乐太大声
scenes.setting: 楼上十一点还在放低音很重的音乐，你第二天六点要起。

lines.en: Hi, sorry to bother you. The music is quite loud.
lines.zh: 你好，不好意思打扰。音乐有点大声。
lines.note: 先说 sorry to bother you，再提问题 —— 直接说太吵容易开战。

lines.en: Oh, I did not realise. Is it coming through the wall?
lines.zh: 哦，我没意识到。是隔着墙传过去的吗？

lines.en: A bit. I work early, so I am in bed by ten.
lines.zh: 有一点。我上班早，十点就睡。

lines.en: Sorry about that. I will turn it down.
lines.zh: 抱歉。我调小。

lines.en: Thanks. And one more thing, the bin bags in the hall.
lines.zh: 谢谢。还有件事，走廊里的垃圾袋。

lines.en: Are they in the way?
lines.zh: 挡路了吗？

lines.en: They have been there since Monday. The whole floor smells.
lines.zh: 周一就在那儿了。整层都有味道。

lines.en: Fair enough. I will take them down tonight.
lines.zh: 说得对。我今晚拿下去。

branch.task: 对方反问，你要把话说清楚又不激化

prompt.en: It is only ten. Is it really that loud?
prompt.zh: 才十点。真有那么吵吗？

say.en: The bass carries. I can hear it in my bedroom.
say.zh: 低音传得远。我卧室里都能听见。

react.en: Fair. I will move the speaker off the wall.
react.zh: 有道理。我把音箱从墙边挪开。

say.en: It is not the volume, it is the hour. I am up at six.
say.zh: 不是音量，是时间。我六点起。

react.en: Understood. Weeknights I will keep it low.

phrases.en: I work early, so I am in bed by ten.

scenes.setting: 洗衣机下面一滩水，地板已经泡了。

lines.en: My washing machine is leaking.
lines.zh: 我的洗衣机在漏水。

lines.en: How old is it?
lines.zh: 用了多久？

lines.en: Two years. It is still under warranty.
lines.zh: 两年。还在保修期内。

lines.en: We can send someone Thursday, between nine and twelve.
lines.zh: 我们周四可以派人，九点到十二点之间。

lines.en: Do I need to be home?
lines.zh: 我需要在家吗？

lines.en: Someone over eighteen has to let him in.
lines.zh: 得有个十八岁以上的人开门。

lines.en: Thursday morning works. Is there a call-out fee?
lines.zh: 周四上午可以。有上门费吗？

lines.en: Not under warranty. Parts are covered too.
lines.zh: 保修期内没有。零件也含。

prompt.en: Thursday morning just went. The earliest now is Monday.

say.zh: 那就周一上午。我在家办公。

react.en: Booked. You will get a text when he sets off.
react.zh: 订好了。他出发时会发短信。

say.en: Can you put me on the cancellation list?
say.zh: 能把我放取消候补吗？

react.en: I can. People often cancel the night before.
react.zh: 可以。很多人前一晚取消。

scenes.name: 见对方父母 · 第一次见家长
scenes.setting: 你第一次去对方父母家吃饭，桌上四个人。

lines.en: So, how did you two meet?
lines.zh: 你们俩怎么认识的？

lines.en: At a wedding, three years ago. We were at the same table.
lines.zh: 三年前一个婚礼上。我们坐同一桌。

lines.en: And you work in computers, is that right?
lines.zh: 你是做计算机的，对吧？

lines.en: Software, yes. I build the parts people do not see.
lines.zh: 软件。我做的是用户看不见的那部分。

lines.en: That sounds complicated.
lines.zh: 听着挺复杂。

lines.en: It is mostly patience, honestly.
lines.zh: 说实话，主要是耐心。

lines.en: Do you cook? She does not, I am afraid.
lines.zh: 你会做饭吗？她不太会。

lines.en: I do. She is better at baking than me.
lines.zh: 会。她烘焙比我强。

branch.task: 对方问了一个不好答的问题，你要稳住

prompt.en: What does your family think about all this?
prompt.zh: 你家里怎么看这件事？

say.en: They are happy for us. They will meet her in the summer.
say.zh: 他们为我们高兴。夏天会见面。

react.en: Good. That matters more than people admit.
react.zh: 好。这比大家承认的更重要。

say.en: They are cautious, like any parents. I am not.
say.zh: 他们跟所有父母一样谨慎。我不是。

react.en: I can respect that answer.

phrases.en: I build the parts people do not see.
phrases.zh: 我做用户看不见的那部分。

phrases.en: Can I help with the dishes?

scenes.setting: 你到校门口，老师把你叫到一边。

lines.en: Are you picking up Mia today?
lines.zh: 今天你来接 Mia？

lines.en: Yes. Her mother is stuck at work.
lines.zh: 是。她妈妈被工作绊住了。

lines.en: She is in the art room. We had a small incident.
lines.zh: 她在美术教室。出了点小事。

lines.en: Is she all right?
lines.zh: 她没事吧？

lines.en: She is. Another child pushed her, and she pushed back.
lines.zh: 没事。另一个孩子推了她，她也推了回去。

lines.en: What happens now?
lines.zh: 现在怎么处理？

lines.en: We spoke to both of them. No punishment, just a talk.
lines.zh: 我们跟两个孩子都谈了。不处罚，只是谈话。

lines.en: Thank you. I will talk to her at home too.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我在家也会跟她谈。

branch.task: 老师问你的处理方式，你要表态

prompt.en: How do you usually handle this at home?
prompt.zh: 你们在家一般怎么处理这种情况？

say.en: We talk about what he could have done instead.
say.zh: 我们聊他本可以怎么做。

react.en: That is consistent with what we do here.
react.zh: 跟我们这边的做法一致。

say.en: I am not sure. This is new for us.
say.zh: 我不太确定。这对我们是新情况。

react.en: Then let us agree on one line to use with her.
react.zh: 那我们统一一句对她说的话。

scenes.name: 调解家里争执 · 兄弟借车不加油
scenes.setting: 家里三个人，你在中间。

lines.en: You always take his side.
lines.zh: 你总是向着他。

lines.en: I am not taking sides. I am asking what happened.
lines.zh: 我没站边。我在问发生了什么。

lines.en: He borrowed the car and brought it back empty.
lines.zh: 他借了车，还回来是空油箱。

lines.en: That is worth saying to him, not to me.
lines.zh: 这话该跟他说，不是跟我说。

lines.en: You know how he reacts.
lines.zh: 你知道他会怎么反应。

lines.en: Then say it in a message, calmly, and copy me.
lines.zh: 那就发消息，平静地说，抄送我。

lines.en: Fine. But I am not apologising for being angry.
lines.zh: 行。但我不会为生气道歉。

lines.en: Nobody asked you to. Just say the thing that is true.
lines.zh: 没人让你道歉。就说事实。

branch.task: 对方在气头上，你要把话降温

prompt.en: So you think I am overreacting.
prompt.zh: 所以你觉得我反应过度。

say.en: I think you are angry, and the fuel is not the real reason.
say.zh: 我觉得你在气，油不是真正的原因。

react.en: Maybe not.

say.en: I did not say that. I asked what happened.
say.zh: 我没这么说。我问的是发生了什么。

react.en: Fine. He also did not thank me.

phrases.en: That is worth saying to him.
Just say the thing that is true.

scenes.name: 咨询养老院 · 轻度失智
scenes.setting: 母亲独居，最近两次忘关煤气。

lines.en: We are looking at care homes for my mother.
lines.zh: 我们在给我妈找养老院。

lines.en: How much support does she need day to day?
lines.zh: 她日常需要多少照护？

lines.en: She can dress herself, but she forgets her medication.
lines.zh: 她能自己穿衣，但会忘记吃药。

lines.en: Then assisted living may be enough, not a nursing home.
lines.zh: 那辅助生活就够了，不用护理院。

lines.en: What is the difference in cost?
lines.zh: 费用差多少？

lines.en: About a third less, and she keeps her own flat.
lines.zh: 便宜大概三分之一，而且她有自己的房间。

lines.en: Can we visit before deciding?
lines.zh: 决定前能来看看吗？

lines.en: Any time. Come for lunch, see how it feels.
lines.zh: 随时。来吃顿午饭，感受一下。

branch.task: 顾问给了一个费用口径，你要问到底

prompt.en: The fee covers the room, meals and care, but not nursing.
prompt.zh: 费用含房间、餐和日常照护，不含护理。

say.en: What does nursing cost when it is needed?
say.zh: 需要护理的时候怎么收？

react.en: About forty a day, only when it is used.
react.zh: 一天四十左右，用的时候才收。

say.en: So the headline fee is not the real cost?
say.zh: 所以标价不是真实费用？

react.en: Not for everyone. It depends on the assessment.
react.zh: 不是对所有人都一样。看评估结果。

phrases.en: How much support does she need?
Assisted living, not a nursing home.
Come for lunch, see how it feels.

scenes.name: 咖啡店点单 · 赶时间的早晨
scenes.setting: 工作日的早晨，街角咖啡店排着队。你只想快点拿到咖啡，别迟到。

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你好！想喝点什么？
lines.note: get started for you 是美国咖啡店的固定问法，字面是「开始给你做」。不是问你要不要开始。

lines.en: Could I get a large latte, please?
lines.zh: 我要一杯大杯拿铁，谢谢。
lines.note: 点单说 Could I get… 比 I want… 礼貌得多，也不用想 Would you… 后面接什么。

lines.en: Sure. Hot or iced?
lines.zh: 好的。热的还是冰的？

lines.en: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
lines.zh: 冰的。能换成燕麦奶吗？

lines.en: We can. That'll be fifty cents extra, is that okay?
lines.zh: 可以。要加五毛钱，行吗？
lines.note: That'll be + 金额，是店员报价格式，听到就知道该掏钱了。

lines.en: That's fine. Oh, and could I get a blueberry muffin too?
lines.zh: 没问题。对了，再来一个蓝莓麦芬。

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿喝还是带走？
lines.note: 英式说 eat in or takeaway，意思一样。

lines.en: To go, please. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 带走。可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course. What name should I put on the cup?
lines.zh: 当然。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.en: Wen. W-E-N. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: Wen，W-E-N。多谢。

scenes.setting: 你和朋友坐在餐厅里，菜还没点，你有坚果过敏。

lines.en: Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
lines.zh: 可以点菜了吗，还是再看一会儿？

lines.en: A few more minutes, please. What do you recommend?
lines.zh: 再看一会儿。有什么推荐吗？

lines.en: The grilled salmon is very popular tonight, and the mushroom soup is a house special.
lines.zh: 今晚烤三文鱼很受欢迎，蘑菇汤是本店招牌。

lines.en: I'll have the salmon. Could I get the sauce on the side?
lines.zh: 那我要三文鱼。酱汁能单独放吗？

lines.zh: 我去问问后厨，然后告诉您。

lines.en: Thank you. Excuse me, could we get the bill? And could we split it?
lines.zh: 谢谢。不好意思，麻烦结账。可以分开付吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Card or cash?
lines.zh: 可以。刷卡还是现金？

lines.en: Card. Everything was delicious, thank you.
lines.zh: 刷卡。菜很好吃，谢谢。

scenes.name: 看医生 · 喉咙痛四天
scenes.setting: 喉咙痛了四天，越来越严重，你去了社区诊所。

lines.en: Come on in and have a seat. What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 进来坐吧。今天哪里不舒服？
lines.note: What brings you in 是医生的标准开场，字面是「什么把你带来的」。

lines.en: I've had a sore throat for about four days, and it's getting worse.
lines.zh: 我喉咙痛了四天左右，越来越严重。
lines.note: 病程用现在完成时：I've had … for four days。说 I have 会被理解为刚开始。

lines.en: Any fever or cough?
lines.zh: 发烧或咳嗽吗？

lines.en: A slight fever last night, thirty-eight degrees. No cough.
lines.zh: 昨晚有点低烧，三十八度。没咳嗽。

lines.en: Let me take a look. It's quite red. Are you allergic to penicillin?
lines.zh: 我看一下。挺红的。你对青霉素过敏吗？

lines.en: I don't think so, but I'm not completely sure.
lines.zh: 应该不过敏，但我不太确定。

lines.en: Then I'll prescribe something milder. Take it three times a day after meals.
lines.zh: 那我开点温和的。一天三次，饭后吃。

lines.en: How long will it take to feel better?
lines.zh: 多久能好？

lines.en: You should see a difference in two or three days. If the fever comes back, come straight back in.
lines.zh: 两三天就该有起色。要是又发烧，直接回来找我。

lines.en: Thank you, doctor. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 谢谢医生，太感谢了。

branch.task: 医生要先做检查，问清楚你真正关心的那件事

prompt.en: Before I take a look, I'd like to run a quick test. Is that all right?
prompt.zh: 在检查之前，我想先做个快速化验，可以吗？

say.en: Is it covered by my insurance?
say.zh: 这个医保能报吗？

react.en: It is, don't worry. Now, are you allergic to penicillin?
react.zh: 能报，别担心。你对青霉素过敏吗？

say.en: Sure. How long will the results take?
say.zh: 可以。结果多久出来？

react.en: About twenty minutes. Meanwhile, are you allergic to penicillin?
react.zh: 大概二十分钟。对了，你对青霉素过敏吗？

phrases.en: I've had a sore throat for four days.
Three times a day after meals.

scenes.name: 看牙医补牙 · 冷热敏感
scenes.setting: 你喝冰水时右边一颗牙刺痛，拖了两个月。

lines.en: When did you last see a dentist?
lines.zh: 上次看牙是什么时候？

lines.en: About two years ago. One tooth hurts when I drink cold water.
lines.zh: 大概两年前。有一颗牙喝冷水会疼。

lines.en: Let me take an X-ray. Does it hurt right now?
lines.zh: 我拍个片子。现在疼吗？

lines.en: Only with cold. Not with hot.
lines.zh: 只有冷的疼。热的没事。
lines.note: 冷疼热不疼，通常是龋齿；反过来可能是牙髓问题 —— 医生就靠这个区分。

lines.en: There is a small cavity. We can fill it today.
lines.zh: 有个小蛀洞。今天就能补。

lines.en: Will it hurt?
lines.zh: 会疼吗？

lines.en: We will numb it. You will feel pressure, not pain.
lines.zh: 会打麻药。你会觉得有压力，不疼。

lines.en: How much will it cost?
lines.zh: 要多少钱？

lines.en: A hundred and twenty, including the X-ray.
lines.zh: 一百二，含拍片。

lines.en: All right. Let us do it.
lines.zh: 好。那就补吧。

branch.task: 医生说情况比预想复杂，你要决定今天做还是改天

prompt.en: The cavity is deeper than the X-ray showed. It may need a root canal.
prompt.zh: 蛀得比片子上深。可能需要根管治疗。

say.en: What does that involve, and what does it cost?
say.zh: 那要怎么做，多少钱？

scenes.name: 急诊处理伤口 · 玻璃划伤
scenes.setting: 你打碎了一个杯子，捡碎片时划开手掌。

lines.en: What seems to be the problem?
lines.zh: 哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I cut my hand on a glass. It will not stop bleeding.
lines.zh: 我的手被玻璃划了。血止不住。

lines.en: Let me see. How long ago?
lines.zh: 我看看。多久之前？

lines.en: Twenty minutes. I have been pressing it with a towel.
lines.zh: 二十分钟。我一直用毛巾按着。

lines.en: You need stitches. Are you on any medication?
lines.zh: 需要缝针。你在吃什么药吗？

lines.en: Just aspirin, one a day.
lines.zh: 只有阿司匹林，一天一片。

lines.en: That thins the blood, so expect a bit more bleeding. Any allergies?
lines.zh: 那会稀释血液，可能会多流一点。有过敏吗？

lines.en: None that I know of.
lines.zh: 据我所知没有。

lines.en: Good. We will numb the area and close it with four stitches.
lines.zh: 好。我们先麻醉，再缝四针。

branch.task: 护士问你的用药情况，你要给准确信息

prompt.en: Do you take anything else? Even supplements count.
prompt.zh: 还在吃别的吗？保健品也算。

say.en: Fish oil and vitamin D, nothing prescription.
say.zh: 鱼油和维生素 D，没有处方药。

react.en: Noted. We will keep pressure on it.

say.en: I took ibuprofen this morning, about four hours ago.
say.zh: 今天早上吃了布洛芬，大概四小时前。

react.en: Good to know. That also affects bleeding.
react.zh: 知道了。那也会影响出血。

phrases.en: I have been pressing it with a towel.

scenes.name: 医疗保险理赔 · 牙科理赔
scenes.setting: 你自费补了牙，想把钱报回来一部分。

lines.en: I need to make a claim for a dental visit.
lines.zh: 我要申请一笔牙科理赔。

lines.en: Do you have the invoice and the receipt?
lines.zh: 有发票和收据吗？

lines.en: I have both, and the treatment notes.
lines.zh: 两样都有，还有治疗记录。

lines.en: Was it an emergency or planned treatment?
lines.zh: 是急诊还是计划内治疗？

lines.en: Planned. I have the pre-approval email from March.
lines.zh: 计划内。我有三月的预审批邮件。
lines.note: pre-approval 是事先审批，有计划治疗一定要先拿，否则可能不报。

lines.en: Then it is covered at seventy percent, up to eight hundred a year.
lines.zh: 那报七成，每年上限八百。

lines.en: I have already used three hundred this year.
lines.zh: 我今年已经用了三百。

lines.en: Then five hundred of cover is left. Send the documents and we will process it.
lines.zh: 那还剩五百额度。把材料寄来我们处理。

branch.task: 额度不够，你要判断剩下的怎么处理

prompt.en: Then only five hundred is left, and the treatment was six hundred.
prompt.zh: 那只剩五百额度，治疗花了六百。

say.en: So I pay the last hundred myself?
say.zh: 那一百我自己付？

react.en: Exactly. We settle it after the claim.

say.en: Can it go against next year?
say.zh: 能算到明年吗？

react.en: Only if the treatment happens next year.
react.zh: 只有治疗发生在明年才行。

phrases.en: I need to make a claim.
Was it planned or an emergency?

lines.zh: 有发票和收据吗？

lines.en: I have both, and the treatment notes.
lines.zh: 两样都有，还有治疗记录。

lines.en: Was it an emergency or planned treatment?
lines.zh: 是急诊还是计划内治疗？

lines.en: I have already used three hundred this year.
lines.zh: 我今年已经用了三百。

prompt.en: Then only five hundred is left, and the treatment was six hundred.
prompt.zh: 那只剩五百额度，治疗花了六百。

say.en: So I pay the last hundred myself?
say.zh: 那一百我自己付？

react.en: Exactly. We settle it after the claim.

say.en: Can it go against next year?
say.zh: 能算到明年吗？

react.en: Only if the treatment happens next year.
react.zh: 只有治疗发生在明年才行。

scenes.name: 心理咨询初诊 · 搬到新城市
scenes.setting: 你搬来两个月，睡不好，也不想上班。

lines.en: What brings you here?
lines.zh: 是什么让你来这儿？

lines.en: I have not been sleeping well, and I cannot focus at work.
lines.zh: 我一直睡不好，工作也集中不了。

lines.en: How long has that been going on?
lines.zh: 持续多久了？

lines.en: About two months, since I moved here.
lines.zh: 大概两个月，从我搬来开始。

lines.en: Do you have anyone here you can talk to?
lines.zh: 这边有能说话的人吗？

lines.en: Not really. Most of my friends are in another time zone.
lines.zh: 不太有。我的朋友大多在另一个时区。

lines.en: That is a lot to carry on your own. What would help most right now?
lines.zh: 这些一个人扛很重。现在最需要什么？

lines.en: I would like to sleep through the night, and to stop dreading Mondays.
lines.zh: 我想一觉睡到天亮，也不想再害怕周一。

branch.task: 咨询师问了一个你不想答的问题，你要决定说多少

prompt.en: What do you think keeps you from meeting people here?

react.en: That is worth staying with for a minute.
react.zh: 这一点值得多聊一会儿。

say.en: I would rather not go there yet.
say.zh: 我还不想谈这个。

react.en: That is fine. We can come back to it.

phrases.en: I have not been sleeping well.

scenes.name: 带猫看兽医 · 猫不吃东西
scenes.setting: 你的猫两天没进食，躲在床底下不出来。

lines.en: What seems to be the problem with her?
lines.zh: 她怎么了？

lines.en: She has not eaten for two days and is hiding under the bed.
lines.zh: 她两天没吃东西，躲在床底下。

lines.en: Any vomiting or change in the litter tray?
lines.zh: 有呕吐吗？猫砂盆里的情况有变化吗？

lines.en: She drank a lot of water yesterday.
lines.zh: 昨天喝了很多水。

lines.en: That can point to the kidneys. We should run blood tests.
lines.zh: 这可能指向肾脏。应该验血。

lines.en: How much will the tests cost?
lines.zh: 化验多少钱？

lines.en: About a hundred and forty, results tomorrow.
lines.zh: 大概一百四，明天出结果。

lines.en: Please do it. She is insured, so I will claim it back.
lines.zh: 那就做。她有保险，我事后报。

branch.task: 兽医提出要加一项检查，你要决定做不做

prompt.en: I would also like to scan her, just in case there is a blockage.
prompt.zh: 我还想给她做个扫描，以防有阻塞。

say.en: If it changes the treatment, do it.
say.zh: 如果会改变治疗方案，那就做。

react.en: It would, in about one case in ten.

say.en: Let us start with the blood tests only.
say.zh: 先只做验血。

react.en: Sensible. We can scan later if needed.

lines.en: I can do that. How will we know it is working?

lines.zh: 谢谢您来。他大部分科目都不错。

lines.en: That is good to hear. Is there anything I should worry about?
lines.zh: 听着不错。有什么我该担心的吗？

lines.en: His reading is strong, but he avoids writing tasks.
lines.zh: 他阅读很强，但总躲着写作。

lines.en: At home he says he does not know what to write.
lines.zh: 在家他说不知道写什么。

lines.en: That is common. We are trying a five-minute free write each morning.
lines.zh: 这很常见。我们每天早上试五分钟自由写作。

lines.en: Should we do the same at home?
lines.zh: 我们在家也这样吗？

lines.en: Ten minutes after dinner, no corrections. Just keep the pen moving.
lines.zh: 晚饭后十分钟，不要改错。让笔一直动。

lines.en: We speak another language at home. Does that slow him down?
lines.zh: 我们在家说另一种语言。会拖慢他吗？

branch.task: 老师给了一个家庭任务，你要问清怎么做

prompt.en: Ten minutes after dinner, no corrections. Just keep the pen moving.
prompt.zh: 晚饭后十分钟，不要改错，让笔一直动。

say.en: What if he writes the same sentence five times?
say.zh: 如果他同一句写五遍呢？

react.en: Let him. Fluency comes before variety.

say.en: Should I read it afterwards?
say.zh: 之后我要看吗？

react.en: Only if he offers. Do not turn it into marking.
react.zh: 他主动给你看才看。别变成批改。

lines.en: We need someone for Saturday evening, about four hours.

lines.zh: 孩子多大？

lines.en: Six and three. The little one goes to bed at seven.
lines.zh: 六岁和三岁。小的七点睡。

lines.zh: 我们俩都会开机。

lines.en: Fifteen an hour, and I will need a taxi home after ten.

scenes.name: 报游泳课 · 成人零基础
scenes.setting: 你三十岁，小时候没学过游泳。

lines.en: I would like to join the adult beginners class.
lines.zh: 我想报成人初级班。

lines.en: Can you swim at all?
lines.zh: 你会游泳吗？

lines.en: Not really. I can float but I panic in deep water.
lines.zh: 不太会。能漂，但深水会慌。

lines.en: Then beginners is right. It runs twice a week for eight weeks.
lines.zh: 那初级班合适。一周两次，八周。

lines.en: How many people in a class?
lines.zh: 一个班多少人？

lines.en: Six, with one teacher and one assistant.
lines.zh: 六个，一个教练一个助教。

lines.en: Do I need to bring anything?
lines.zh: 要带什么吗？

lines.en: Just a costume, a towel and a lock for the locker.
lines.zh: 泳衣、毛巾，还有锁柜子的锁。

branch.task: 前台问你的水性，你要如实说

prompt.en: Can you put your face in the water without panicking?
prompt.zh: 你能把脸放进水里不慌吗？

say.en: Not yet. That is the part I want to fix.
say.zh: 还不行。这正是我想解决的。

react.en: Then we start there, in the shallow end.

say.en: I can, but I hold my nose.
say.zh: 可以，但我得捏鼻子。

react.en: We will teach you to breathe out slowly.

phrases.en: I can float but I panic in deep water.
How many people in a class?
Do I need to bring anything?

scenes.name: 找 IT 修电脑 · 连不上公司 wifi
scenes.setting: 早上九点，三个人的电脑同时连不上网。

lines.en: My laptop will not connect to the office wifi since this morning.
lines.zh: 我的笔记本今早开始连不上办公室 wifi。

lines.en: Does it connect anywhere else?
lines.zh: 别的地方能连吗？

lines.en: At home it works fine. Two colleagues on this floor have the same problem.
lines.zh: 在家没问题。这层楼有两个同事也一样。

lines.en: Then it is the access point, not your machine.
lines.zh: 那是接入点的问题，不是你的机器。

lines.en: Should I log a ticket?
lines.zh: 我要提工单吗？

lines.en: I will log one and copy your manager.
lines.zh: 我提一个，抄送你经理。

lines.en: How long until it is fixed?
lines.zh: 多久能好？

lines.en: The replacement arrives this afternoon. Use the meeting room wifi until then.
lines.zh: 替换件下午到。这之前用会议室的 wifi。

branch.task: 对方要你提供信息，你要判断哪些能给

prompt.en: Send me your password so I can log in and test it.
prompt.zh: 把密码发我，我登进去测一下。

say.en: I would rather not. Can you reset it instead?
say.zh: 我不太想。能重置吗？

react.en: Fair. I will send a reset link.

say.en: Our policy says never share it. Can you use remote access?
say.zh: 公司规定不能给。你能远程接入吗？

react.en: Good answer. I will use the admin console.

phrases.en: It will not connect since this morning.

scenes.setting: 你晚上看屏幕总要眯眼，来配新眼镜。

lines.en: When did you last have your eyes tested?
lines.zh: 上次验光是什么时候？

lines.en: Three years ago. I squint at the screen by the evening.
lines.zh: 三年前。到晚上看屏幕会眯眼。

lines.en: Let us check. Read the smallest line you can.
lines.zh: 查一下。读你能看清的最小一行。

lines.en: The fourth one. The fifth is a blur.
lines.zh: 第四行。第五行是糊的。

lines.en: You are slightly short-sighted, and the astigmatism has moved.
lines.zh: 轻度近视，散光轴位也变了。

lines.en: Do I need new glasses, or just new lenses?
lines.zh: 要换整副，还是只换镜片？

lines.en: New lenses in the same frame is cheaper.
lines.zh: 同框换镜片便宜些。

lines.en: How long will that take?
lines.zh: 要多久？

branch.task: 验光师建议一项附加服务，你要判断

prompt.en: I would add the anti-fatigue coating. It helps with screens.
prompt.zh: 我建议加抗疲劳镀膜。对屏幕有帮助。

say.en: How much extra?
say.zh: 加多少钱？

react.en: Thirty. It lasts as long as the lenses.

say.en: Does it actually work, or is it marketing?
say.zh: 真有用还是营销？

react.en: It helps some people. Not everyone notices.
react.zh: 对部分人有用。不是人人有感。

phrases.en: New lenses in the same frame.

scenes.name: 看体检报告 · 胆固醇偏高
scenes.setting: 年度体检报告出来，家庭医生约你谈。

lines.en: Your results are back. Most of it is normal.
lines.zh: 报告出来了。大部分正常。

lines.en: Most of it? What is not?
lines.zh: 大部分？哪项不正常？

lines.en: Your cholesterol is a little high, and vitamin D is low.
lines.zh: 胆固醇偏高一点，维生素 D 偏低。

lines.en: Does that need medication?
lines.zh: 需要吃药吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Diet and a supplement, then we retest in three months.
lines.zh: 暂时不用。调整饮食加补充剂，三个月后复查。

lines.en: What should I change in my diet?
lines.zh: 饮食要怎么改？

lines.en: Less fried food, more fish, and twenty minutes outside a day.
lines.zh: 少吃油炸，多吃鱼，每天户外二十分钟。

lines.en: Can I get a copy of the numbers?
lines.zh: 能给我一份具体数值吗？

branch.task: 医生问你生活习惯，你要如实答

prompt.en: How many units of alcohol do you drink a week?
prompt.zh: 你一周喝多少酒？

say.en: About ten, mostly at weekends.
say.zh: 大概十个单位，多在周末。

react.en: That is within the limit, but it affects cholesterol.
react.zh: 在建议范围内，但会影响胆固醇。

say.en: Very little. Maybe twice a month.
say.zh: 很少。一个月两次。

react.en: Then diet is the main lever.

scenes.name: 理疗第一次 · 搬箱子闪了腰
scenes.setting: 搬完家腰疼六周，坐久了更难受。

lines.en: Where does it hurt?
lines.zh: 哪里疼？

lines.en: Lower back, mostly on the left, worse in the morning.
lines.zh: 下背，多偏左，早上更明显。

lines.en: How long has it been like this?
lines.zh: 这样多久了？

lines.en: Six weeks. It started after I moved flats.
lines.zh: 六周。搬完家开始的。

lines.en: Lifting boxes, probably. Let me test your range.
lines.zh: 大概是搬箱子。我测一下活动度。

lines.en: Will I need scans?
lines.zh: 需要做检查吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Six sessions of this usually settles it.
lines.zh: 暂时不用。一般六次治疗能缓过来。

lines.en: What can I do between sessions?
lines.zh: 两次之间我能做什么？

branch.task: 理疗师要你做一个动作测试，你要说清感受

prompt.en: Bend forward slowly and tell me when it pulls.
prompt.zh: 慢慢前弯，哪里拉紧就告诉我。

say.en: Now, on the left, just above the hip.
say.zh: 现在，左边，髋部上方。

react.en: That is the spot I expected.

say.en: It is more of a dull ache than a pull.
say.zh: 更像是钝痛，不是拉紧。

react.en: Good. That changes the exercise.

phrases.en: What can I do between sessions?

scenes.name: 戒烟咨询 · 一天十五支
scenes.setting: 你咳嗽了两个月，决定戒烟。

lines.en: How many a day?
lines.zh: 一天几支？

lines.en: About fifteen. More at weekends.
lines.zh: 十五支左右。周末更多。

lines.en: Have you tried stopping before?
lines.zh: 以前试过戒吗？

lines.en: Twice. I lasted a week both times.
lines.zh: 两次。都只撑了一周。

lines.en: Then let us plan it, not just pick a date.
lines.zh: 那我们来做个计划，不只是挑个日子。

lines.en: What does the plan involve?
lines.zh: 计划包括什么？

lines.en: Patches, a quit date in two weeks, and someone to call.
lines.zh: 贴片、两周后的戒烟日，还有一个能打电话的人。

lines.en: Can I still come to you if I slip?
lines.zh: 如果我破戒了还能来找你吗？

react.en: Then we plan for that night, not just the day.

lines.en: Yes, feet up. It passes in a few minutes.
lines.zh: 躺下，脚抬高。几分钟就好。

lines.en: Most people are. Have you eaten today?
lines.zh: 多数人都怕。今天吃东西了吗？

lines.en: A light breakfast, about three hours ago.
lines.zh: 吃了点早饭，大概三小时前。

lines.en: Good. Have some water and sit here.
lines.zh: 好。喝点水，坐这儿。

lines.en: How long does it take?
lines.zh: 要多久？

lines.en: Ten minutes for the donation, twenty resting after.
lines.zh: 采血十分钟，之后休息二十分钟。

lines.en: Can I drive home afterwards?
lines.zh: 之后能开车回家吗？

branch.task: 护士做筛查问话，你要如实答

prompt.en: Have you had a tattoo or piercing in the last four months?
prompt.zh: 最近四个月有纹身或穿孔吗？

say.en: A piercing in June, so four months ago exactly.
say.zh: 六月打了个洞，正好四个月。

react.en: Then we wait a week to be safe.

say.en: No, neither.
say.zh: 没有，都没有。

react.en: Good. Let us get you set up.

scenes.name: 咨询牙齿矫正 · 成人门牙重叠
scenes.setting: 你三十二岁，门牙越来越挤，笑起来不敢露齿。

lines.en: Have you seen an orthodontist before?

lines.zh: 没有。我门牙重叠，越来越明显。

lines.en: How old are you? Adults take longer than teenagers.
lines.zh: 你多大？成人比青少年慢。

lines.zh: 大概多少钱？

lines.zh: 有便宜点的吗？

scenes.name: 听力检查 · 左耳听不清
scenes.setting: 你开会总听漏，家人说你电视开太响。

lines.en: Which ear is worse?
lines.zh: 哪只耳朵差一些？

lines.en: The left. I keep asking people to repeat themselves.
lines.zh: 左边。我总让别人重复。

lines.en: Any ringing?
lines.zh: 有耳鸣吗？

lines.en: A high tone at night, mostly when it is quiet.
lines.zh: 晚上有高音，安静的时候明显。

lines.en: Let us do a hearing test. It takes twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 做个听力测试。二十分钟。

lines.en: If I need hearing aids, are they covered?
lines.zh: 如果需要助听器，能报吗？

lines.en: Partially, through the health service. Private ones cost more.
lines.zh: 公立的能报一部分。自费更贵。

lines.en: How long do the batteries last?
lines.zh: 电池能用多久？

branch.task: 听力师问你的日常影响，你要给具体场景

prompt.en: Does it affect you at work or only at home?
prompt.zh: 影响工作还是只在家里？

say.en: Meetings. I nod and hope I heard it right.
say.zh: 开会。我点头，希望自己听对了。

react.en: That is exactly what we need to fix first.
react.zh: 这正是我们首先该解决的。

say.en: Mostly television and restaurants.
say.zh: 主要是电视和餐厅。

react.en: Restaurants are the hardest for everyone.
react.zh: 餐厅对所有人都是最难的。

phrases.en: I keep asking people to repeat.

scenes.name: 工资条看不懂 · 实发变少
scenes.setting: 你发现这个月实发比上月少了一百多。

lines.en: Could you explain my payslip? The net pay is lower than last month.
lines.zh: 能解释一下我的工资条吗？实发比上月少。

lines.en: You had two days of unpaid leave. That is the difference.
lines.zh: 你请了两天无薪假。差额就在这儿。

lines.en: I thought leave was paid.
lines.zh: 我以为请假是带薪的。

lines.en: Only statutory leave. The rest is unpaid.
lines.zh: 只有法定假带薪。其余没有。

lines.en: And what is this deduction here?
lines.zh: 这一项扣的是什么？

lines.en: National insurance. It goes up when you earn more.
lines.zh: 国民保险。收入高了扣得也多。

lines.en: Can I get a breakdown in writing?
lines.zh: 能给我一份书面明细吗？

lines.en: I will email it today.
lines.zh: 我今天发邮件。

branch.task: 人事要你确认一个数字，你要能对得上

prompt.en: Before I send it, what figure did you expect for net pay?
prompt.zh: 发之前先确认，你预计实发多少？

say.en: About two thousand one hundred, based on last month.
say.zh: 大概两千一，按上月算的。

react.en: That matches my calculation. I will send it now.
react.zh: 跟我算的一样。我现在发。

say.en: I do not know. That is why I am asking.
say.zh: 我不知道。所以才来问。

react.en: Fair. I will walk you through line by line.

scenes.name: 第一次报税 · 第一次报税
scenes.setting: 你工作第一年，卖了点股票，不确定要不要报。

lines.en: I need help filing my tax return. It is my first year.
lines.zh: 我需要帮忙报税。这是我第一年。

lines.en: Are you employed or self-employed?
lines.zh: 你是雇员还是自雇？

lines.en: Employed, but I also sold some shares.
lines.zh: 雇员，但我也卖了一些股票。

lines.en: Then you need to declare the gains.
lines.zh: 那你要申报这部分收益。

lines.en: Is there an allowance?
lines.zh: 有免税额吗？

lines.en: Three thousand a year before tax is due.
lines.zh: 一年三千以内不征税。

lines.en: Do I need to file if I am under that?
lines.zh: 不到这个数还要报吗？

lines.en: Not usually, but keep the records for five years.
lines.zh: 一般不用，但记录要留五年。

branch.task: 顾问问你要证据，你没有全部

prompt.en: Do you have the contract notes for the share sales?

say.en: The platform keeps them. I can download the year summary.
say.zh: 平台有记录。我能下载年度汇总。

react.en: That is enough for the return.

say.en: I only have screenshots of the app.
say.zh: 我只有 app 截图。

react.en: It will do, but request the official statement too.
react.zh: 也能用，但最好再要一份正式对账单。

phrases.en: Keep the records for five years.

lines.en: I would like to ask about a personal loan.
lines.zh: 我想咨询个人贷款。

lines.en: How much do you need, and for how long?
lines.zh: 要多少，多久还？

lines.zh: 五千，两年。

lines.en: The rate would be six percent, fixed.
lines.zh: 利率六个点，固定。

lines.en: Are there early repayment charges?
lines.zh: 提前还款有罚金吗？

lines.en: None after the first year.
lines.zh: 一年后没有。

lines.en: What do you need from me?
lines.zh: 需要我提供什么？

lines.en: Three months of statements and your ID.
lines.zh: 三个月流水和证件。

say.zh: 那我是借五千零九十？

lines.en: Then we will freeze it and raise a dispute.
lines.zh: 那我们冻结这张卡并发起争议。

lines.en: Will I get the money back while you investigate?
lines.zh: 调查期间钱能先退吗？

lines.en: Usually within ten days, as a temporary credit.
lines.zh: 一般十天内，作为临时入账。

scenes.name: 看房问条件 · 二楼没电梯
scenes.setting: 你看的第三套房，价格合适但临街。

lines.en: The flat is on the second floor, no lift.
lines.zh: 房子在二楼，没有电梯。

lines.en: That is fine. Is the rent negotiable?
lines.zh: 可以。房租能谈吗？

lines.en: It is fixed at nine hundred, bills not included.
lines.zh: 定死九百，不含水电。

lines.en: What do the bills come to on average?
lines.zh: 水电平均多少？

lines.en: About a hundred and twenty in winter.
lines.zh: 冬天大概一百二。

lines.en: How long is the minimum tenancy?
lines.zh: 最短租多久？

lines.en: Twelve months, with a six-month break clause.
lines.zh: 十二个月，六个月后有解约条款。
lines.note: break clause 是提前解约条款，签长约前一定要问。

lines.en: Could I see the bedroom again? The window faces the road.
lines.zh: 能再看一眼卧室吗？窗户朝马路。

lines.en: It does, but the glazing is new.
lines.zh: 是朝马路，但玻璃是新换的。

react.en: Then I can do eleven months at the same rent.

say.zh: 先一年。我刚搬来。

react.en: Fair. We can review it after.

scenes.name: 签租约 · 首次签约
scenes.setting: 你第一次在这边租房，合同有十二页。

lines.en: Here is the tenancy agreement. Read it before you sign.
lines.zh: 这是租约。签之前先读。

lines.en: Thanks. Is my deposit protected in a scheme?
lines.zh: 谢谢。押金会进监管账户吗？
lines.note: deposit protection scheme 是押金保护机制，英国法定要求。

lines.en: It is, and you will get the certificate within thirty days.
lines.zh: 会，三十天内给您证书。

lines.en: What does the break clause say?
lines.zh: 解约条款怎么写的？

lines.en: Six months, with two months notice.
lines.zh: 六个月后，提前两个月通知。

lines.en: Can I put up shelves?
lines.zh: 我能装隔板吗？

lines.en: Only with written permission.
lines.zh: 要书面许可。

lines.en: And who pays for repairs?
lines.zh: 维修谁出钱？

lines.en: The landlord covers the structure. You cover what you break.
lines.zh: 结构问题房东负责。你弄坏的你负责。

lines.zh: 书面报修了吗？

lines.en: And can I deduct the cost from the rent?

lines.en: Keep the receipt. Deducting is allowed after notice.
lines.zh: 留好收据。通知之后可以扣。
lines.note: deduct from rent 是「从房租里扣」，要走完通知流程才合法。

scenes.name: 房东要涨租 · 涨百分之八
scenes.setting: 你住了两年，房东第一次提涨租。

lines.en: We are proposing a rent increase from July.
lines.zh: 我们想从七月起涨租。

lines.en: By how much?
lines.zh: 涨多少？

lines.en: Eight percent, which is in line with the market.
lines.zh: 百分之八，符合市场水平。

lines.en: That is above inflation. What is the justification?
lines.zh: 这高于通胀。依据是什么？

lines.en: The area has moved up. Comparable flats are higher.
lines.zh: 这一片涨了。同类房子都更贵。

lines.en: Can we agree on five percent for two years?
lines.zh: 能不能定五年、两年不涨？

lines.en: I would need to ask the owner.
lines.zh: 我得问业主。

lines.en: Please do. I would rather stay than move.
lines.zh: 请去问。我更想留下，不想搬。

lines.en: I will come back to you by Friday.
lines.zh: 周五前回复你。

react.en: Send me three examples and I will look.

say.en: I have been here two years with no gaps in payment.
say.zh: 我住了两年，从没拖欠。

react.en: That counts for something. I will say so to the owner.
react.zh: 这确实有价值。我会跟业主说。

phrases.en: I would rather stay than move.

lines.zh: 请去问。我更想留下，不想搬。

lines.en: I will come back to you by Friday.

scenes.name: 看合租房 · 看合租单间
scenes.setting: 你换城市工作，先合租半年过渡。

lines.en: Hi, I saw your ad for the room.
lines.zh: 你好，我看到你发的房间广告。

lines.en: Are you working or studying?
lines.zh: 你工作还是上学？

lines.en: Working, full time, in an office three days a week.
lines.zh: 工作，全职，一周三天在办公室。

lines.en: The room is seven hundred, bills included.
lines.zh: 房间七百，含水电。

lines.en: When could I move in?
lines.zh: 什么时候能搬进来？

lines.en: The first of next month. Can you view this week?
lines.zh: 下个月一号。这周能来看吗？

lines.en: Thursday evening works. Who else lives here?
lines.zh: 周四晚上可以。还有谁住这儿？

lines.en: Two of us, both quiet. We keep the kitchen clean.
lines.zh: 我们两个人，都挺安静。厨房大家保持干净。

branch.task: 对方提了一个合同安排，你要判断接不接受

prompt.en: Just so you know, we do a trial month before the contract.
prompt.zh: 先说一下，签合同前有一个试用月。

say.en: A trial month sounds sensible. Same rent?
say.zh: 试用月挺合理。房租一样吗？

react.en: Same rent, and you can leave after four weeks.

say.en: Is anything signed during the trial?
say.zh: 试用期要签什么吗？

react.en: Only the house rules. No contract yet.
react.zh: 只签居住公约。还不签合同。

scenes.name: 中介费与审核 · 被收审核费
scenes.setting: 你在网上看到一套房，中介要先收两百审核费。

lines.en: The referencing fee is two hundred.
lines.zh: 审核费两百。

lines.en: I thought agency fees were banned.
lines.zh: 我以为中介费已经禁了。

lines.en: Agency fees are. This is a referencing fee, which is allowed.
lines.zh: 中介费禁了。这是审核费，允许收。

lines.en: What does the referencing cover?
lines.zh: 审核包括什么？

lines.en: Credit check, employer letter, previous landlord.
lines.zh: 信用查询、雇主证明、前房东评价。

lines.en: And if I fail the check?
lines.zh: 如果我没通过呢？

lines.en: You lose the fee but nothing else.
lines.zh: 费用不退，其余没有损失。

lines.en: Could I provide a guarantor instead?
lines.zh: 我能提供担保人代替吗？

lines.en: You can. It usually removes the credit requirement.
lines.zh: 可以。通常就不用信用查询了。

branch.task: 中介给你的替代方案有硬条件，你要确认能不能满足

prompt.en: A guarantor has to own property here and sign for the whole rent.
prompt.zh: 担保人得在本地有房产，并为全部房租担保。

say.en: My uncle owns a flat here. Would that work?
say.zh: 我叔叔在这儿有套房。可以吗？

react.en: It would. We need his ID and a mortgage statement.
react.zh: 可以。需要他的证件和房贷对账单。

say.en: Then I will take the credit check instead.
say.zh: 那我还是走信用查询吧。

react.en: Simpler, if your record is clean.

lines.en: How far is the move?
lines.zh: 搬多远？

lines.en: About six miles, same city.
lines.zh: 大概六英里，同城。

lines.en: Any stairs or a lift?
lines.zh: 有楼梯还是电梯？

lines.en: Third floor, no lift at either end.
lines.zh: 三楼，两边都没电梯。

lines.en: That adds an hour. Roughly four hundred, including packing materials.
lines.zh: 那要多一小时。大概四百，含包装材料。

lines.en: Does that include dismantling the bed?
lines.zh: 包含拆床吗？

lines.en: It does. We can also reassemble it at the new place.
lines.zh: 包含。到新家也能装回去。

lines.en: What is covered if something breaks?
lines.zh: 东西坏了保到什么程度？

branch.task: 报价比你预期高，你要砍价或减项

prompt.en: Four hundred is the weekday price. Saturdays are four eighty.
prompt.zh: 四百是工作日价。周六四百八。

say.en: Then I will take a weekday and book time off.
say.zh: 那我要工作日，请一天假。

react.en: Tuesday is our quietest day.

say.en: Can you drop the packing materials to bring it down?
say.zh: 去掉包装材料能便宜点吗？

react.en: Minus forty, but you supply the boxes.
react.zh: 少四十，但纸箱你自己准备。

phrases.en: I need a quote for a move.

scenes.name: 装宽带 · 新家装光纤
scenes.setting: 你刚租下商铺楼上的房子，两个人在家办公。

lines.en: I would like to set up broadband at my new flat.
lines.zh: 我想在新家装宽带。

lines.en: What is the postcode?
lines.zh: 邮编是多少？

lines.en: It is the flat above the shop on Mill Street.
lines.zh: 磨坊街商铺楼上那套。

lines.en: We can do fibre there. Which package suits you?
lines.zh: 那边能装光纤。您要哪个套餐？

lines.en: Two people, both working from home. Something reliable.
lines.zh: 两个人都在家办公。要稳定的。

lines.en: The middle package is sixty a month, and it is not shared.
lines.zh: 中间那个套餐每月六十，不是共享带宽。
lines.note: not shared 是「独享带宽」，多人上网时不掉速。

lines.en: Is there a setup fee?
lines.zh: 有安装费吗？

lines.en: Normally thirty, but it is free on an eighteen-month contract.
lines.zh: 一般三十，签十八个月免费。

lines.en: What if I move before then?
lines.zh: 如果我在那之前搬家呢？

react.en: Half the speed between seven and ten.

react.en: Eighty. It is worth it if you both work from home.

scenes.name: 水电开户 · 开通电力
scenes.setting: 你搬进新租的房子，前租客已经销户。

lines.en: I have just moved in and need to set up the electricity.
lines.zh: 我刚搬进来，要开通电。

lines.en: Is the supply already on?
lines.zh: 现在有电吗？

lines.en: It is, but the previous tenant closed the account.
lines.zh: 有，但前租客把账户销了。

lines.en: I need a meter reading from the day you moved in.
lines.zh: 需要您入住当天的电表读数。

lines.en: I took a photo on the first day. Will that do?
lines.zh: 我第一天拍了照。可以吗？

lines.en: Perfect. Are you on a fixed or variable rate?
lines.zh: 很好。您要固定价还是浮动价？

lines.en: Fixed, if the price is reasonable.
lines.zh: 价格合理的话要固定价。

lines.en: Fixed for twelve months is slightly higher, but it will not move.
lines.zh: 固定十二个月略贵，但不会变。

lines.en: I will take fixed. Can I set up a direct debit?
lines.zh: 那要固定价。能设自动扣款吗？

prompt.en: We need the reading from the move-in date, not today.

say.zh: 房东在交接单上写了。能发照片吗？

react.en: A photo of the inventory is fine.

say.en: Can the engineer read it and backdate the bill?
say.zh: 能让工程师来抄表并按那天算吗？

react.en: We can, but there is a fifteen charge.

phrases.en: Can I set up a direct debit?

scenes.name: 请保洁上门 · 两居室常规保洁
scenes.setting: 你工作忙，厨房和浴室已经顾不上两周了。

lines.en: I would like a cleaner for a two-bedroom flat, once a fortnight.
lines.zh: 我想请保洁，两居室，两周一次。

lines.en: Is it a deep clean or a regular one?
lines.zh: 是深度保洁还是常规保洁？

lines.en: Regular. The kitchen needs attention though.
lines.zh: 常规。不过厨房需要重点处理。

lines.en: That is fine. Two hours is usually enough.
lines.zh: 可以。一般两小时够。

lines.en: Do I need to be home?
lines.zh: 我需要在家吗？

lines.en: Most clients leave a key or a code. It is up to you.
lines.zh: 多数客户留钥匙或密码。看您方便。

lines.en: I would rather be here the first time.
lines.zh: 第一次我还是在家。

lines.en: Sensible. Two hours is fifty, and the products are included.
lines.zh: 这样稳妥。两小时五十，耗材包含在内。

lines.en: I can be there in twenty minutes. It is eighty for a lockout.

lines.en: I have one in my bag. Will you damage the lock?

lines.en: Not if it is a standard cylinder. I will pick it, not drill it.
lines.zh: 标准锁芯就不会。我技术开锁，不钻孔。

scenes.name: 装洗衣机 · 换洗衣机
scenes.setting: 旧机用了十年，新机当天送到。

lines.en: Delivery and install for the washing machine?
lines.zh: 洗衣机送货加安装？

lines.en: Yes. It is replacing an old one, first floor, no lift.
lines.zh: 是。替换旧的，二楼，没电梯。

lines.en: We need to disconnect the old one. Is the valve working?
lines.zh: 要先拆旧的。水阀好用吗？

lines.en: It is. I turned it off yesterday and nothing leaked.
lines.zh: 好用。我昨天关了，没漏。

lines.en: Good. We can take the old one away for fifteen.
lines.zh: 好。旧机我们可以带走，十五。

lines.en: Please do. Do you need a parking space?
lines.zh: 那就带走。需要停车位吗？

lines.en: The van needs ten minutes. There is a bay outside?
lines.zh: 货车停十分钟。外面有位子吗？

lines.en: There is, but it is a loading bay until six.
lines.zh: 有，但六点前是卸货区。

branch.task: 安装条件比你预期复杂，要改方案

prompt.en: The old machine is plumbed in with fixed copper pipe. We cannot disconnect it.
prompt.zh: 旧机是固定铜管接的。我们拆不了。

say.en: Then leave it and fit the new one beside it?
say.zh: 那别拆，把新的装在旁边？

react.en: There is not enough width. You need a plumber.

say.en: Can you come back after the plumber?
say.zh: 水管工弄完你们能再来吗？

react.en: We can, but there is a second call-out fee.
react.zh: 可以，但要再收一次上门费。

phrases.en: It is replacing an old one.
We can take the old one away.

scenes.setting: 你半夜听见水槽下面有动静，面粉被咬开了。

lines.en: What have you seen?
lines.zh: 您看到了什么？

lines.en: Droppings under the sink, and something moving at night.
lines.zh: 水槽下面有粪便，晚上有东西在动。

lines.en: Any damage to food packaging?
lines.zh: 食品包装有被咬吗？

lines.en: Two bags of flour were chewed open.
lines.zh: 两袋面粉被咬开了。

lines.en: That sounds like mice. We can treat this week.
lines.zh: 听起来是老鼠。这周就能处理。

lines.en: Is it safe with a cat in the flat?
lines.zh: 家里有猫，安全吗？

lines.en: Traps in the kitchen, bait only in locked boxes.
lines.zh: 厨房用夹子，诱饵只放在锁盒里。

lines.en: How long until they are gone?
lines.zh: 多久能清干净？

react.zh: 那就是入口。我们会封上。

say.zh: 我没看过。现在看一下？

react.en: Take a photo and send it before we come.

scenes.name: 找灭虫公司 · 臭虫
scenes.setting: 你怀疑床上有臭虫。

lines.en: What have you seen?
lines.zh: 您看到了什么？

lines.en: I wake up with bites in a line on my arm.
lines.zh: 我醒来手臂上有一排咬痕。

lines.en: That is usually bedbugs. It needs two treatments.
lines.zh: 一般是臭虫。要做两次。

lines.en: Two bags of flour were chewed open.
lines.zh: 两袋面粉被咬开了。

lines.en: That sounds like mice. We can treat this week.
lines.zh: 听起来是老鼠。这周就能处理。

lines.en: Is it safe with a cat in the flat?
lines.zh: 家里有猫，安全吗？

lines.en: Traps in the kitchen, bait only in locked boxes.
lines.zh: 厨房用夹子，诱饵只放在锁盒里。

lines.en: How long until they are gone?
lines.zh: 多久能清干净？

scenes.name: 退换货 · 拉链坏了
scenes.setting: 上周买的外套拉链坏了，你带着电子收据回到店里。

lines.en: Hi, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 你好，需要什么帮助？

lines.en: I bought this jacket last week, but the zip is broken. I'd like to return it.
lines.zh: 我上周买了这件外套，拉链坏了。我想退掉。

lines.en: Do you have the receipt with you?
lines.zh: 您带收据了吗？

lines.en: I have it on my phone. Will that do?
lines.zh: 手机里有电子收据。这样可以吗？
lines.note: Will that do? ＝这个行不行？口语里极常用，比 Is that okay 更地道。

lines.en: That's fine. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
lines.zh: 可以。您想退款还是换货？

lines.en: An exchange, if you have it in a medium.
lines.zh: 换一件吧，有 M 码吗？

lines.en: Let me check the stock. We have one in navy. Would you like to try it on?
lines.zh: 我查一下库存。有一件藏青色的。要试一下吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Where's the fitting room?
lines.zh: 好的。试衣间在哪？

lines.en: Just over there. Take your time.
lines.zh: 就在那边。慢慢试。

lines.en: It fits well. I'll take this one, thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 挺合身，就这件吧，谢谢。

branch.task: 没有你要的尺码，选一个退路

say.en: Could you order one in for me?

react.en: It'd be here by Thursday. We do have one in navy, if you want to try the large.
react.zh: 周四能到。不过我们有件藏青的，您可以先试试大号。

say.en: I'll take the large, then, if it fits.
say.zh: 那就要大号吧，如果合身的话。

react.en: There's one in navy. Go ahead and try it.

phrases.en: Do you have it in a medium?
Would you like to try it on?

scenes.name: 超市买东西 · 搬新家补货
scenes.setting: 你刚搬进新公寓，冰箱是空的，来楼下超市补货。

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the milk?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，牛奶在哪儿？

lines.en: Aisle four, on the left.
lines.zh: 四号通道，左手边。
lines.note: aisle 是货架之间的通道，超市里问路全靠这个词。

lines.en: Thanks. And do you have eggs?
lines.zh: 谢谢。有鸡蛋吗？

lines.en: Yes, right next to the milk.
lines.zh: 有，就在牛奶旁边。

lines.en: Great, I will grab both.
lines.zh: 好，我两样都拿。

lines.en: Do you need a bag?
lines.zh: 要袋子吗？

lines.en: Yes, one please.
lines.zh: 要一个，谢谢。

lines.en: That comes to twelve forty.
lines.zh: 一共十二块四。

lines.en: Card, please. Can I get cash back?
lines.zh: 刷卡。能顺便取点现金吗？
lines.note: cash back 是刷卡时多刷一笔拿现金，超市收银台常见。

lines.en: Sure. How much would you like?
lines.zh: 可以。您要多少？

branch.task: 现金返还的方式有限制，你要决定还用不用

prompt.en: Cash back is debit cards only, sorry.
prompt.zh: 不好意思，只有借记卡才能取现金。

say.en: I will use my debit card then.
say.zh: 那我用借记卡。

react.en: Great. How much would you like?

say.en: Never mind, just the shopping.
say.zh: 算了，就结账吧。

react.en: No problem. Twelve forty, done.

scenes.setting: 你拿着三件衣服进了试衣间，第一件就卡在肩膀上。

lines.en: How many items?

lines.en: Three, thanks.
lines.zh: 三件，谢谢。

lines.en: The limit is four. The last room on the right is free.
lines.zh: 最多四件。最右边那间空着。

scenes.name: 手机店修电池 · 电池撑不到下午
scenes.setting: 手机用两年了，电池撑不到下午，你走进街角的维修店。

lines.en: Hi, are you looking for a new phone?
lines.zh: 你好，想买新手机吗？

lines.en: Just looking. My battery dies by noon.
lines.zh: 先看看。我电池到中午就没电了。
lines.note: dies 用在电池上是「没电了」，不是「死掉」。

lines.en: That sounds like a worn battery. We can replace it for forty.
lines.zh: 那像是电池老化了。换一块四十。

lines.en: Really? How long does it take?
lines.zh: 真的？要多久？

lines.en: About an hour. Or you could trade it in.
lines.zh: 大概一小时。也可以折价换新。

lines.en: What would a trade-in be worth?
lines.zh: 折价能值多少？
lines.note: trade in 是旧机折价，名词形式 trade-in。

lines.en: Around a hundred, depending on the condition.
lines.zh: 大概一百，看机况。

lines.en: I will do the battery first. Do I need an appointment?
lines.zh: 我先换电池吧。要预约吗？

lines.en: No, but there is a two-hour wait today.
lines.zh: 不用，但今天要等两小时。

branch.task: 对方说你的机型修不了，你要换个方案

prompt.en: Actually, your model is on the list we cannot open. The glass is glued to the frame.
prompt.zh: 其实你这个型号我们不能拆，玻璃是粘在框上的。

say.en: So what are my options?
say.zh: 那我有什么选择？

react.en: Trade it in as is, or send it to the official service centre.
react.zh: 按现状折价，或者送官方售后。

say.en: How much would the official centre charge?
say.zh: 官方售后要多少钱？

react.en: Around a hundred and twenty, and it takes a week.

phrases.zh: 我电池到中午就没电了。

phrases.en: What would a trade-in be worth?

scenes.name: 手机店修电池 · 屏幕碎了
scenes.setting: 手机摔过，屏幕右下角裂了但还能用，你想知道修多少钱。

lines.en: Hi, are you looking for a new phone?
lines.zh: 你好，想买新手机吗？

lines.en: My screen cracked. It still works, but the corner is sharp.
lines.zh: 我屏幕裂了。还能用，但角上很刮手。
lines.note: dies 用在电池上是「没电了」，不是「死掉」。

lines.en: We can do the glass for ninety, or the whole screen for a hundred and sixty.
lines.zh: 换外层玻璃九十，换整块屏一百六。

lines.en: Is the cheaper one as good?
lines.zh: 便宜的那种一样好吗？

lines.en: The glass is original. The full screen is a copy, so it can feel slower.
lines.zh: 外层玻璃是原厂的。整块屏是副厂的，触感会差一点。

lines.en: What would a trade-in be worth?
lines.zh: 折价能值多少？
lines.note: trade in 是旧机折价，名词形式 trade-in。

lines.en: Around a hundred, depending on the condition.
lines.zh: 大概一百，看机况。

lines.en: I will think about it. Thanks for the quote.
lines.zh: 我再想想。谢谢报价。

lines.en: No problem. We are open till seven.
lines.zh: 没事。我们开到七点。

scenes.setting: 手机掉进水里，你当时还试着开机，现在充不进电。

lines.en: Hi, are you looking for a new phone?
lines.zh: 你好，想买新手机吗？

lines.en: It fell in water and I tried to turn it on. Now it will not charge.

lines.note: trade in 是旧机折价，名词形式 trade-in。

lines.en: Around a hundred, depending on the condition.
lines.zh: 大概一百，看机况。

lines.en: Let me sleep on it. I will come back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我想想。明天再来。

lines.en: Sure. Keep it dry until then.
lines.zh: 好。这之前别再碰水。

scenes.name: 家具店量尺寸 · 窗下那块空地
scenes.setting: 你搬进新公寓，卧室只有窗下一块空地能放书桌。

lines.en: Can I help you find anything?
lines.zh: 需要帮您找什么吗？

lines.en: I am looking for a desk, something small.
lines.zh: 我想找一张书桌，小一点的。

lines.en: How wide is the space?
lines.zh: 空间有多宽？

lines.en: About a meter. It has to fit under the window.
lines.zh: 大概一米。得能塞进窗户下面。

lines.en: This one is ninety centimeters. It comes flat-packed.
lines.zh: 这张九十厘米。是平板包装的。
lines.note: flat-packed 是自己回家组装的平板包装，宜家那种。

lines.en: Do you deliver?
lines.zh: 你们送货吗？

lines.en: Yes, thirty for delivery, or free if you pick it up.
lines.zh: 送，三十块运费。自提免费。

lines.en: I will take it. Can I pay now and pick it up Saturday?
lines.zh: 我要了。能现在付、周六来取吗？

branch.task: 送货时间有变，你要调整安排

prompt.en: Delivery is thirty, but we cannot do Saturdays.
prompt.zh: 送货三十，但周六送不了。

say.en: A weekday evening, then?
say.zh: 那工作日晚上呢？

react.en: Thursday after six works.

say.en: I will collect it myself.
say.zh: 那我自己来取。

react.en: Then it is free. Bring a friend, it is heavy.
react.zh: 那就免费。带个朋友来，挺沉的。

phrases.en: I am looking for a desk.

scenes.name: 菜市场买水果 · 周六早市
scenes.setting: 周六早市，你想买点能生吃的西红柿，摊主开价偏高。

lines.en: Tomatoes, two fifty a pound.
lines.zh: 西红柿，两块五一磅。

lines.en: That is a bit much. How about two?
lines.zh: 有点贵。两块行吗？

lines.en: Two twenty, and I will throw in an onion.
lines.zh: 两块二，再送你一个洋葱。
lines.note: throw in 是「白送、搭一个」，菜市场砍价的标准收尾。

lines.en: Deal. Two pounds, please.
lines.zh: 成交。来两磅。

lines.en: Anything else? The peaches came in this morning.
lines.zh: 还要别的吗？桃子今早到的。

lines.en: Are they sweet?
lines.zh: 甜吗？

lines.en: Very. Try a piece.
lines.zh: 很甜。尝一块。

lines.en: They are good. I will take four.
lines.zh: 不错。来四个。

branch.task: 对方不肯让价，你要决定买还是不买

prompt.en: Two fifty is already the early price. I cannot go lower.
prompt.zh: 两块五已经是早市价了，不能再低。

say.en: All right, two pounds then.
say.zh: 行，那来两磅。

react.en: Good choice. Anything else?

say.en: I will look around first.
say.zh: 我先转转。

react.en: Suit yourself. I am here till noon.

phrases.en: I will throw in an onion.

scenes.name: 快递点寄退货 · 开箱就是裂的
scenes.setting: 网购的显示器开箱就裂了，你按客服说的来寄回去。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: I need to return this. The screen came cracked.
lines.zh: 我要退这个。屏幕到货就是裂的。
lines.note: 电商退货说 return，保修维修说 repair —— 两者流程完全不同。

lines.en: Do you have the return label?
lines.zh: 有退货面单吗？

lines.en: Yes, it is on my phone.
lines.zh: 有，在手机里。

lines.en: I need it printed. There is a printer by the door.
lines.zh: 得打印出来。门边有打印机。

lines.en: All right. Does it need to be boxed?
lines.zh: 好。需要装箱吗？

lines.en: Please. And keep the tracking slip.
lines.zh: 要装。还有，收好这张追踪单。

lines.en: Will the refund go through once it is scanned?
lines.zh: 他们一扫码就退款吗？

lines.en: Usually the same day it reaches the warehouse.
lines.zh: 一般到仓当天就退。

branch.task: 对方没有包装箱，你要临时解决

prompt.en: We have run out of boxes today.
prompt.zh: 今天我们箱子用完了。

say.en: Can I buy one next door?
say.zh: 我能去隔壁买一个吗？

react.en: The shop on the corner sells them for two pounds.

say.en: I will bring it back tomorrow in my own box.
say.zh: 我明天用自己箱子拿回来。

react.en: Fine. Keep the label, it stays valid for a week.
react.zh: 行。面单留着，一周内有效。

phrases.en: Do you have the return label?
Does it need to be boxed?

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?

lines.en: I need to return this. The screen came cracked.

scenes.name: 快递点寄退货 · 包裹丢了
scenes.setting: 你上个月寄的包裹一直没到，单号也查不到。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: I sent a parcel three weeks ago and the tracking has not moved.
lines.zh: 我三周前寄了个包裹，物流一直没动。
lines.note: 电商退货说 return，保修维修说 repair —— 两者流程完全不同。

lines.en: Let me see the tracking number. If it is lost, we open a claim.
lines.zh: 给我看单号。如果丢了，我们提查件。

lines.en: Here it is. How long does a claim take?
lines.zh: 在这儿。查件要多久？

lines.en: About two weeks. If it turns up, we will call you.
lines.zh: 大概两周。要是找到了，我们会打给您。

lines.en: Thanks. That is all for today.
lines.zh: 谢谢。今天就这些。

lines.en: Sorry about the trouble.
lines.zh: 给您添麻烦了。

lines.en: Not your fault. Have a good day.
lines.zh: 不是你们的错。祝你今天顺利。

lines.en: You too.
lines.zh: 你也是。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: Do you do pickups? The box is too big for me to carry.
lines.zh: 你们上门取件吗？箱子太大我搬不动。
lines.note: 电商退货说 return，保修维修说 repair —— 两者流程完全不同。

lines.en: We do, for five pounds. Book online before noon.
lines.zh: 可以，五镑。中午前在网上预约。

lines.en: Booked. Can they come tomorrow morning?
lines.zh: 约好了。他们能明天上午来吗？

lines.en: Morning slots go fast. Leave it at the door if you are out.
lines.zh: 上午的时段很抢手。你不在家就放门口。

lines.en: Should I box it before they come?
lines.zh: 他们来之前我要装箱吗？

lines.en: Please. And keep the tracking slip.
lines.zh: 要装。还有，收好这张追踪单。

lines.en: Will the refund go through once it is scanned?
lines.zh: 他们一扫码就退款吗？

lines.en: Usually the same day it reaches the warehouse.
lines.zh: 一般到仓当天就退。

branch.task: 对方没有包装箱，你要临时解决

prompt.en: We have run out of boxes today.
prompt.zh: 今天我们箱子用完了。

say.en: Can I buy one next door?
say.zh: 我能去隔壁买一个吗？

react.en: The shop on the corner sells them for two pounds.

say.en: I will bring it back tomorrow in my own box.
say.zh: 我明天用自己箱子拿回来。

react.en: Fine. Keep the label, it stays valid for a week.
react.zh: 行。面单留着，一周内有效。

phrases.en: Do you have the return label?

scenes.name: 买跑鞋 · 第一次买跑鞋
scenes.setting: 你开始跑步，需要一双正经的跑鞋，但不知道自己该穿多大。

lines.en: What size are you looking for?

scenes.name: 给同事挑礼物 · 同事生孩子
scenes.setting: 同事刚生了孩子，办公室凑份子，你负责去买。

lines.en: Looking for a gift?
lines.zh: 在挑礼物吗？

lines.en: Yes, for a colleague who just had a baby.
lines.zh: 是，送给刚生孩子的同事。

lines.en: How much do you want to spend?
lines.zh: 预算多少？

lines.en: Around twenty, not more.
lines.zh: 二十左右，不超过。

lines.en: This blanket is eighteen, and it is very soft.
lines.zh: 这条毯子十八，很软。

lines.en: Nice. Can you gift wrap it?
lines.zh: 不错。能包装一下吗？

lines.en: For three more. Would you like a card?
lines.zh: 加三块。要卡片吗？

lines.en: Just the wrap, thanks. And what is your return policy?
lines.zh: 只包装就行。你们的退换政策是什么？

lines.en: Thirty days with the receipt, no questions asked.
lines.zh: 带收据三十天，不问理由。

prompt.en: We are out of gift boxes, only paper bags left.
prompt.zh: 礼盒用完了，只剩纸袋。

say.en: A bag is fine, as long as it is not see-through.
say.zh: 纸袋也行，只要不透。

react.en: These are thick. I will add ribbon.

say.en: Could you order a box for tomorrow?
say.zh: 能订个盒子明天取吗？

react.en: I can, if you can come back.
react.zh: 可以，如果您能再来一趟。

phrases.en: How much do you want to spend?

phrases.zh: 你们的退换政策是什么？

scenes.setting: 同事搬了新家，办了个小型派对，你一个人来的。

lines.en: You made it! Come in.
lines.zh: 你来了！进来。

lines.en: Thanks for having me. What can I bring?
lines.zh: 谢谢邀请。我带点什么？
lines.note: Thanks for having me 是做客的标准开场，比 thanks for inviting 更自然。

lines.en: Nothing, you are already here. Drinks are in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 什么都不用，人来了就行。饮料在厨房。

lines.en: I brought some wine. Where should I put it?
lines.zh: 我带了瓶酒。放哪儿？

lines.en: On the table by the window. Have you met Sam?
lines.zh: 窗边那张桌子。你见过 Sam 吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Could you introduce us?
lines.zh: 还没有。能介绍一下吗？

lines.en: Sam, this is Wen. She just moved into the building.
lines.zh: Sam，这是 Wen。她刚搬进这栋楼。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. How do you know the host?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。你怎么认识主人的？

branch.task: 有人递给你一样你不想吃或不想喝的东西

prompt.en: Try this, I made it myself. It is quite strong.

say.en: Just a small one, thanks.
say.zh: 少来一点，谢谢。

react.en: Careful, it goes down too easily.

say.en: I am driving tonight, so none for me.
say.zh: 我今晚开车，就不喝了。

react.en: Fair enough. There is plenty of soda.

scenes.name: 同事家的派对 · 想早走
scenes.setting: 你明天要早起，想礼貌地先走。

lines.zh: Sam，这是 Wen。她刚搬进这栋楼。

lines.en: I should head off soon. Thanks again for tonight.
lines.zh: 我该走了。今晚多谢。

scenes.name: 第一次约会 · 朋友介绍的约会
scenes.setting: 朋友介绍你们认识，第一次单独吃饭，气氛有点拘谨。

lines.en: So how do you know Alex?
lines.zh: 你怎么认识 Alex 的？

lines.en: We worked together two years ago. You?
lines.zh: 两年前一起工作过。你呢？

lines.en: We were at university. He has not changed at all.
lines.zh: 我们大学同学。他一点没变。

lines.en: That is either good or worrying.
lines.zh: 这要么是好事，要么挺让人担心。

lines.en: Mostly good. So what do you do when you are not at work?
lines.zh: 基本是好事。那你不上班的时候做什么？

lines.en: I climb on weekends. Badly, but often.
lines.zh: 我周末攀岩。水平很差，但很勤。

lines.en: I have always wanted to try that. Is it expensive to start?
lines.zh: 我一直想试。入门贵吗？

lines.en: Not really. You can rent everything at the gym.
lines.zh: 不贵。装备在馆里都能租。

say.zh: 除非你因为我喜欢就评判我。

react.en: Deal. I will come and watch.

react.en: The height. All of it.

scenes.name: 邀请同事来家里 · 周六晚饭
scenes.setting: 你想请几个同事来家里吃饭，第一次开口。

lines.en: We are having a few people over on Saturday. Would you like to come?
lines.zh: 周六我们家来几个人。你来吗？
lines.note: have people over 是「在家招待人」，比 invite to my home 自然。

lines.en: That sounds nice. What is the occasion?
lines.zh: 听着不错。什么 occasion？

lines.en: No occasion. Just dinner and a lot of talking.
lines.zh: 没什么 occasion。就是吃顿饭，聊聊天。

lines.en: Can I bring anything?
lines.zh: 要带什么吗？

lines.en: A dessert, if you like. Nothing else.
lines.zh: 愿意的话带个甜点。别的不用。

lines.en: What time should I come?
lines.zh: 我几点到？

lines.en: Seven, but come at seven thirty if you want to miss the chaos.
lines.zh: 七点，但想避开混乱就七点半来。

lines.en: Seven thirty it is. Should I bring my partner?
lines.zh: 那就七点半。要带我伴侣吗？

branch.task: 对方提了一个你需要现场决定的限制

prompt.en: Two of the guests are allergic to nuts. Is that workable?
prompt.zh: 有两位客人对坚果过敏。能安排吗？

say.en: I will keep nuts off the menu entirely.
say.zh: 我菜单里完全不放坚果。

react.en: Then nobody has to worry.

say.en: I will label everything clearly.
say.zh: 我会把每样都标清楚。

react.en: That works too.

phrases.en: We are having a few people over.

scenes.name: 婉拒一个邀请 · 周末加班
scenes.setting: 朋友临时约你周末出门，你已经累到不想动。

lines.en: We are going to the coast this weekend. Want to join?
lines.zh: 这周末我们去海边。一起来吗？

lines.en: That sounds great, but I have to work Saturday.
lines.zh: 听着很好，但我周六要上班。

lines.en: Sunday, then? We are staying one night.
lines.zh: 那周日呢？我们住一晚。

lines.en: I would love to, but I am already stretched thin this month.
lines.zh: 我很想去，但这个月我已经排满了。
lines.note: stretched thin 是「精力被摊得太薄」，比 I am busy 更具体也更诚恳。

lines.en: No worries. Another time.
lines.zh: 没事。下次。

lines.en: Definitely. Let me know when you go again.
lines.zh: 一定。你们再去的时候告诉我。

prompt.en: Are you sure? A weekend away would do you good.
prompt.zh: 你确定？出去一个周末对你有好处。

say.en: I know, but I would be poor company right now.
say.zh: 我知道，但我现在状态不好，陪不好人。

react.en: Fair enough. Rest well.

say.en: Can I take a rain check?
say.zh: 能改天吗？

react.en: Any time. I will ask again in a month.

phrases.en: I would love to, but I am already stretched thin.

scenes.setting: 你和室友合住三个月，卫生一直靠自觉，现在不行了。

lines.en: Can we talk about the flat for a minute?
lines.zh: 能聊一下房子的事吗？

lines.en: Sure. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: 行。怎么了？

lines.en: The bins have not gone out for a week, and the kitchen is getting bad.
lines.zh: 垃圾一周没拿出去，厨房开始有味儿了。

lines.en: I thought you were doing bins this week.
lines.zh: 我以为这周你负责垃圾。

lines.en: We never actually agreed on that. That is the problem.
lines.zh: 我们其实没定过。问题就在这儿。

lines.en: Fair. Shall we write it down?
lines.zh: 有道理。写下来？

lines.en: Yes. Bins on Tuesday, bathroom on Sunday, and dishes daily.
lines.zh: 好。周二倒垃圾，周日打扫浴室，碗每天洗。

lines.en: Deal. I will put it on the fridge.
lines.zh: 成交。我贴冰箱上。

say.zh: 我们没明说过，而且我一直在做两样。

react.en: Then I owe you two weeks of bins.

say.en: Fine, but let us write the rest down too.
say.zh: 行，但其余也写下来。

react.en: Agreed. Fridge, tonight.

scenes.name: 安慰与吊唁 · 同事父亲去世
scenes.setting: 同事请假一周后回来上班，你想说点什么又怕说错。

lines.en: I heard about your father. I am so sorry.
lines.zh: 我听说了你父亲的事。真的很难过。
lines.note: I am so sorry 在吊唁里是标准说法，不是道歉。

lines.en: Thank you. It was sudden.
lines.zh: 谢谢。很突然。

lines.en: I cannot imagine. How are you holding up?
lines.zh: 我难以想象。你还撑得住吗？

lines.en: Some days are fine. Some are not.
lines.zh: 有些天还好。有些天不行。

lines.en: That sounds about right. Is there anything I can take off your plate?
lines.zh: 这很正常。有什么我能替你分担的吗？
lines.note: take something off your plate 是「替你分担工作」。

lines.en: The Friday report, if you could cover it once.
lines.zh: 周五那份报告，能帮我顶一次吗？

lines.en: Consider it done. Do not think about it again.
lines.zh: 交给我。别再想它了。

lines.en: That means more than you know.
lines.zh: 这比你知道的更重要。

branch.task: 对方说了句矛盾的话，你要接住

prompt.en: The Friday report. But I do not want people to think I cannot cope.
prompt.zh: 周五那份报告。但我不想让人觉得我扛不住。

say.en: Nobody thinks that. Taking help is not the same as failing.
say.zh: 没人会这么想。接受帮忙不等于扛不住。

react.en: I needed to hear that.

say.en: I will do it quietly. Nobody has to know.
say.zh: 我低调地做，没人会知道。

react.en: That helps. Thank you.

lines.en: The band starts at nine, so that works.

lines.en: Good. Should we book a taxi in advance?
lines.zh: 好。要提前订出租车吗？

lines.en: What should I wear?

lines.en: Closed shoes. It gets cold in the back.
lines.zh: 包脚的鞋。后面挺冷。

lines.en: Understood. Where do I put my bag?
lines.zh: 明白。包放哪儿？

scenes.name: 报名语言班 · 报通用英语班
scenes.setting: 你在这座城市待一年，想把口语练起来。

lines.en: Hi, I would like to join a general English course.
lines.zh: 你好，我想报一个通用英语班。

lines.en: Have you taken a test with us before?
lines.zh: 您在我们这儿考过测试吗？

lines.en: No. Could I do a placement test?
lines.zh: 没有。能做分级测试吗？
lines.note: placement test 是分级测试，决定你进哪个班，不是考试入学。

lines.en: Of course. It takes about forty minutes.
lines.zh: 当然。大概四十分钟。

lines.en: That is fine. How often do the classes run?
lines.zh: 可以。课多久一次？

lines.en: Twice a week, evenings or Saturdays.
lines.zh: 一周两次，晚上或周六。

lines.en: Evenings suit me better. What is the fee?
lines.zh: 晚上更适合我。学费多少？

lines.en: Three hundred and twenty for twelve weeks.
lines.zh: 十二周三百二。

lines.en: Is there a discount if I pay upfront?
lines.zh: 一次付清有折扣吗？

lines.en: Five percent, and you can change class once.
lines.zh: 九折，而且可以换一次班。

branch.task: 测试结果和你预期的不一样，你要决定进哪个班

prompt.en: Your test puts you in intermediate, but the evening intermediate class is full.
prompt.zh: 测试结果是中级，但晚上的中级班满了。

say.en: Could I take the morning class instead?
say.zh: 那我能上周中的上午班吗？

react.en: We have space on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

say.en: How long is the waiting list?
say.zh: 候补要等多久？

react.en: Two weeks, usually. People drop out.

phrases.en: Could I do a placement test?

scenes.name: 小组作业分工 · 分报告章节
scenes.setting: 四个人一组，报告下周五交，还没分工。

lines.en: Shall we split the report now, so nobody doubles up?
lines.zh: 现在分一下报告吧，免得重复做。

lines.en: Good idea. I can take the introduction and the method.
lines.zh: 好主意。我可以写引言和方法。

lines.en: I will do the results and the charts.
lines.zh: 我来做结果和图表。

lines.en: That leaves the discussion. Who wants it?
lines.zh: 剩下讨论部分。谁写？

lines.en: Sam said he would, but he has not answered since Monday.
lines.zh: Sam 说他要写，但周一起就没回消息。

lines.en: Then we should have a backup. Can you draft it if he goes quiet?
lines.zh: 那我们得有个后手。他不吭声的话你能起草吗？

lines.en: I can, but I need his data by Wednesday.
lines.zh: 可以，但我周三前要他的数据。

lines.en: I will message him today and copy you.
lines.zh: 我今天给他发消息，抄送你。

prompt.en: Sam just emailed. He is dropping the module.

react.en: I will take the discussion if you take his charts.

react.en: Worth asking. Losing a member is a valid reason.
react.zh: 值得问。少一个人是正当理由。

scenes.name: 找老师问成绩 · 论文分数偏低
scenes.setting: 你觉得评分不公，但想先弄清楚标准。

lines.en: Do you have a minute? I would like to ask about my essay grade.
lines.zh: 您有空吗？我想问一下论文成绩。

lines.en: Of course. Which question?
lines.zh: 当然。哪一题？

lines.en: Question two. I got fifty-eight, and I am not sure why.
lines.zh: 第二题。我得了五十八，不太清楚原因。

lines.en: Your argument was solid, but the sources were thin.
lines.zh: 你的论证扎实，但文献太少。

lines.en: I cited four. Was that not enough for this length?
lines.zh: 我引了四篇。这个篇幅还不够吗？

lines.en: For a three-thousand-word essay, I expect eight to ten.
lines.zh: 三千字的论文，我希望八到十篇。

lines.en: That is fair. Is there any chance to resubmit?
lines.zh: 有道理。有机会重交吗？
lines.note: resubmit 是重新提交，问的时候要接受「没有」这个答案。

lines.en: Not for this one, but come to me before the next essay.
lines.zh: 这次不行，但下一篇之前来找我。

scenes.name: 课堂演讲被打断 · 被追问数据来源
scenes.setting: 课堂展示，你讲到第二页就被打断。

lines.en: Today I will cover three points: the problem, the data, and what we suggest.
lines.zh: 今天讲三点：问题、数据、以及我们的建议。

lines.en: Sorry to interrupt. Where did the data come from?
lines.zh: 抱歉打断。数据从哪儿来的？

lines.en: Good question. It is the city survey from last year, about four thousand responses.
lines.zh: 好问题。是去年的城市调查，大约四千份回复。

lines.en: Was it a random sample?
lines.zh: 是随机抽样吗？

lines.en: Mostly. They weighted it by age and district.
lines.zh: 基本是。他们按年龄和区做了加权。

lines.en: All right. Sorry, go on.
lines.zh: 好。抱歉，继续。

lines.en: Thanks. So the second point is what changed after the policy.
lines.zh: 谢谢。第二点是政策之后发生了什么变化。

lines.en: One more thing. How confident are you in the last number?
lines.zh: 还有一点。最后一个数字你有多大把握？

react.en: That is a good answer.

say.en: I would need to rerun it with this year data.
say.zh: 要用今年的数据重跑一遍。

react.en: Could you do that before the final?

prompt.zh: 什么情况会改变你的结论？

say.en: If the response rate had been lower, the numbers would not hold.
say.zh: 如果回复率更低，这些数字就站不住。

react.en: That is a good answer.

say.en: I would need to rerun it with this year data.
say.zh: 要用今年的数据重跑一遍。

react.en: Could you do that before the final?

scenes.name: 课堂演讲被打断 · 紧张卡住
scenes.setting: 你忘词了。

lines.en: Today I will cover three points: the problem, the data, and what we suggest.
lines.zh: 今天讲三点：问题、数据、以及我们的建议。

lines.en: Sorry to interrupt. Where did the data come from?
lines.zh: 抱歉打断。数据从哪儿来的？

lines.en: Sorry, let me start that again.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我重说一遍。

lines.en: Was it a random sample?
lines.zh: 是随机抽样吗？

lines.en: Mostly. They weighted it by age and district.
lines.zh: 基本是。他们按年龄和区做了加权。

lines.en: All right. Sorry, go on.
lines.zh: 好。抱歉，继续。

lines.en: Thanks. So the second point is what changed after the policy.
lines.zh: 谢谢。第二点是政策之后发生了什么变化。

lines.en: One more thing. How confident are you in the last number?
lines.zh: 还有一点。最后一个数字你有多大把握？

scenes.name: 网课平台出问题 · 视频播不了
scenes.setting: 你晚上抽时间上课，视频卡在第二分钟。

lines.en: The video for week three will not play. It stops after two minutes.
lines.zh: 第三周的视频放不了。两分钟就停。

lines.en: Which browser are you using?
lines.zh: 您用什么浏览器？

lines.en: Chrome, on a laptop. It works on my phone, but I want the big screen.
lines.zh: 笔记本上的 Chrome。手机能放，但我想用大屏。

lines.en: Try clearing the cache, or using a different browser.
lines.zh: 试试清缓存，或者换个浏览器。

lines.en: I did both. Same result.
lines.zh: 都试了。一样。

lines.en: Then it may be the file. I will report it and unlock the next module for you.
lines.zh: 那可能是文件问题。我上报，并给您解锁下一模块。

lines.en: Thanks. Will the quiz still count?
lines.zh: 谢谢。测验还算数吗？

lines.en: It will. The deadline moves with the unlock.
lines.zh: 算。截止日跟着顺延。
