scenes.name: 街头问路 · 找药店
scenes.setting: 你在陌生城市找一家药店，手机没电了，只能问人。

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Is there a pharmacy near here?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，不好意思。附近有药店吗？
lines.note: sorry to bother you 是开口第一句的缓冲垫，不说这句直接问会显得突兀。

lines.en: Sure. Go straight down this street and take the second left.
lines.zh: 有。沿这条街一直走，第二个路口左转。

lines.en: The second left. Is it far?
lines.zh: 第二个路口左转。远吗？

lines.en: Not at all, about five minutes on foot. It's next to the bank.
lines.zh: 不远，走路大概五分钟。就在银行旁边。
lines.note: on foot＝步行。走路五分钟说 five minutes on foot，不说 by walk。

lines.en: Great. Is it open on Sundays?
lines.zh: 好。周日开门吗？

lines.en: I think so, until six. If it's closed, there's another one by the station.
lines.zh: 应该开，到六点。要是关了，车站那边还有一家。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 帮了大忙，太谢谢了。

lines.en: No problem. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 不客气，过得愉快！
lines.note: Have a good one 是美式口语告别，比 Have a nice day 更随意。

branch.task: 对方说药店可能关了，把方向问清楚

prompt.en: Actually, I think that one closed down last month.
prompt.zh: 其实那家上个月好像关了。

say.en: Is there another one nearby?
say.zh: 附近还有别的药店吗？

react.en: There's one by the station, about ten minutes that way.
react.zh: 车站那边有一家，往那边走十分钟左右。

say.en: Then I'll try the one by the station.
say.zh: 那我试试车站那家。

react.en: Good idea. It's about ten minutes that way.
react.zh: 好主意。往那边走十分钟左右。

phrases.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
It's about five minutes on foot.

scenes.name: 街头问路 · 找地铁站
scenes.setting: 你拖着箱子出站，找不到地铁入口，天又快黑了。

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest subway station?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，最近的地铁站在哪儿？
lines.note: sorry to bother you 是开口第一句的缓冲垫，不说这句直接问会显得突兀。

lines.en: Two blocks that way, next to the bakery.
lines.zh: 往那边两个街区，面包店旁边。

lines.en: Two blocks. Does it have an elevator?
lines.zh: 两个街区。有电梯吗？

lines.en: It does, on the corner. Look for the glass box.
lines.zh: 有，在街角。找那个玻璃盒子就行。
lines.note: on foot＝步行。走路五分钟说 five minutes on foot，不说 by walk。

lines.en: Great. And does it run late?
lines.zh: 太好了。地铁运营到很晚吗？

lines.en: Until midnight on weekdays.
lines.zh: 平日到午夜。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 帮了大忙，太谢谢了。

lines.en: No problem. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 不客气，过得愉快！
lines.note: Have a good one 是美式口语告别，比 Have a nice day 更随意。

scenes.name: 街头问路 · 找厕所

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.

scenes.setting: 你租了车，想上高速，但导航一直把你往小巷里带。

lines.en: No, it is free. The tunnel is the one that charges.

scenes.name: 街头问路 · 手机没电
scenes.setting: 你手机没电，又不会念这条街的英文名，只能指给对方看。

lines.en: My phone died. Could you show me on your map?
lines.zh: 我手机没电了。能在你的地图上指给我看吗？
lines.note: sorry to bother you 是开口第一句的缓冲垫，不说这句直接问会显得突兀。

lines.en: Sure, where are you trying to go?
lines.zh: 可以，你要去哪儿？

lines.en: This address. I cannot pronounce it.
lines.zh: 这个地址。我念不出来。

lines.en: That is ten minutes on foot. I will walk you to the corner.
lines.zh: 走路十分钟。我送你到路口。
lines.note: on foot＝步行。走路五分钟说 five minutes on foot，不说 by walk。

lines.en: Great. Is it open on Sundays?
lines.zh: 好。周日开门吗？

lines.en: I think so, until six. If it's closed, there's another one by the station.
lines.zh: 应该开，到六点。要是关了，车站那边还有一家。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 帮了大忙，太谢谢了。

lines.en: No problem. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 不客气，过得愉快！

say.en: Then I'll try the one by the station.

react.en: Good idea. It's about ten minutes that way.

It's about five minutes on foot.

scenes.name: 机场值机 · 行李有点多
scenes.setting: 国际航班起飞前两小时，你在值机柜台前，行李有点多。

scenes.name: 打车去机场 · 赶飞机
scenes.setting: 你出门晚了，离登机只剩一个半小时，拦下一辆出租。

lines.en: Hi, are you free?
lines.zh: 你好，空车吗？

lines.en: Where to?
lines.zh: 去哪儿？

lines.en: The airport, Terminal 2.
lines.zh: 机场，二号航站楼。

lines.en: That is about forty minutes with this traffic.
lines.zh: 这个点堵，大概四十分钟。

lines.en: That is fine. Could you take the motorway?
lines.zh: 行。能走高速吗？

lines.en: Sure, it is faster, but there is a toll.
lines.zh: 可以，快一些，但要过路费。

lines.en: No problem. Roughly how much will it be?
lines.zh: 没问题。大概多少钱？
lines.note: roughly 是「大概」，打车问价先说 roughly，司机不会觉得你在压价。

lines.en: Around thirty-five, plus the toll.
lines.zh: 三十五左右，过路费另算。

lines.en: Good. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 好。能刷卡吗？

lines.en: Yes, the machine takes cards.
lines.zh: 能，机器支持刷卡。

branch.task: 对方报的价比你预期高，你要决定接受还是换方案

prompt.en: With the toll it will be nearer fifty. Still want the motorway?
prompt.zh: 加过路费差不多五十。还是走高速吗？

say.en: Fine, I am in a hurry.
say.zh: 行，我赶时间。

react.en: Then the motorway it is.

say.en: Take the normal road, then. I have time.
say.zh: 那走普通路吧，我有时间。

react.en: Your call. It will be slower but cheaper.

phrases.en: Roughly how much will it be?

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?

lines.en: Where do I buy a ticket?

lines.en: Hi, I have a booking under Chen.
lines.zh: 你好，我用陈的名字订了车。

lines.en: Found it. Compact, three days. Licence and card, please.
lines.zh: 找到了。紧凑型，三天。驾照和卡。

lines.en: Here they are. Is insurance included?
lines.zh: 都在这儿。含保险吗？

lines.zh: 基本险含。全险一天十二。

lines.en: Good choice. The car is in bay seven.

lines.en: Does it come with a full tank?

lines.en: Full to full. Bring it back full or we charge for the fuel.

lines.en: Excuse me, how long is the delay?

lines.en: About three hours, due to weather.
lines.zh: 大约三小时，天气原因。

lines.en: Will I still make my connection?
lines.zh: 我还赶得上转机吗？

lines.en: It will be tight. Come to the desk and we will rebook you.
lines.zh: 会很紧。到柜台来，我们给您改签。

lines.en: Can you put me on the next flight instead?

lines.en: There is one at four, but it is full. I can waitlist you.

lines.en: Please do. And what about a meal voucher?
lines.zh: 那就候补吧。餐券呢？

lines.en: Here is one for fifteen. Sorry for the trouble.
lines.zh: 这张十五的。给您添麻烦了。

lines.en: Thanks. Where do I wait for the waitlist call?
lines.zh: 谢谢。候补叫号在哪儿等？

lines.en: By gate twelve. I will call your name.
lines.zh: 十二号登机口。我会叫您名字。

scenes.name: 转机找登机口 · 转机五十分钟
scenes.setting: 你只有五十分钟，前一段还晚点了十分钟。

lines.en: Excuse me, where do I go for a connecting flight?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，转机往哪边走？

lines.en: Follow the purple signs for transfers.
lines.zh: 跟着紫色的转机指示走。

lines.en: My connection is in fifty minutes. Is that enough?
lines.zh: 我下一班五十分钟后。来得及吗？

lines.en: It is tight but doable. Which gate?
lines.zh: 有点紧，但来得及。哪个登机口？

lines.en: B42. Do I need to go through security again?
lines.zh: B42。还要再过安检吗？

lines.en: Not from this terminal. Just keep walking.
lines.zh: 这个航站楼不用。一直走就行。

lines.en: And if I miss it, where do I rebook?
lines.zh: 如果我没赶上，在哪儿改签？

lines.en: The transfer desk at the end of this corridor.
lines.zh: 这条走廊尽头的转机柜台。

react.en: It is twenty minutes extra. You have thirty.

say.en: Is there another route to gate B42?

react.en: The walkway on level two stays open.

scenes.name: 机场退税 · 服装和电子产品
scenes.setting: 你买了八百镑的东西，想退一成多的税。

lines.en: I would like to claim a tax refund on these purchases.
lines.zh: 我想为这些购物办退税。

lines.en: Do you have the forms and the receipts?
lines.zh: 有退税单和收据吗？

lines.en: Yes, all in this envelope.
lines.zh: 有，都在这个信封里。

lines.en: Are the goods in your checked luggage or with you?
lines.zh: 东西在托运行李里还是随身？

lines.en: In the suitcase. Should I bring them out?
lines.zh: 在箱子里。要拿出来吗？

lines.en: I need to see them before you check the bag in.
lines.zh: 我要在托运前看一眼。
lines.note: 退税的关键顺序：先海关验货，再托运 —— 反了就退不了。

lines.en: How long does the refund take to reach my card?
lines.zh: 退款多久到卡上？

lines.en: About four weeks. Keep the stamped copy.
lines.zh: 大概四周。留好盖章的副本。

lines.en: That was there when I picked it up. It is on the check-out sheet.
lines.zh: 我取车时就有。取车单上记了。

lines.en: The gauge shows full. Here is your receipt.

scenes.setting: 晚上十一点到民宿，楼道很暗。

lines.en: The key is in the lock box by the door. The code is 4471.
lines.zh: 钥匙在门边的密码盒里。密码 4471。

lines.en: I am at the door but the box will not open.
lines.zh: 我到门口了，但盒子打不开。

lines.en: On the card by the router, in the hall.

lines.en: The heating is not coming on. Is there a switch?
lines.zh: 暖气不热。有开关吗？

lines.en: The thermostat is behind the living room door. Set it to twenty.
lines.zh: 温控器在客厅门后。调到二十度。

scenes.name: 民宿自助入住 · 退房
scenes.setting: 你想知道怎么还钥匙。

lines.en: The key is in the lock box by the door. The code is 4471.
lines.zh: 钥匙在门边的密码盒里。密码 4471。

lines.en: I am at the door but the box will not open.
lines.zh: 我到门口了，但盒子打不开。

lines.en: Try pressing the numbers firmly, then pull the shackle down.
lines.zh: 数字按实一点，然后把锁梁往下拉。

lines.en: It opened. Thank you. Where is the wifi password?
lines.zh: 开了。谢谢。wifi 密码在哪儿？

lines.en: On the card by the router, in the hall.
lines.zh: 在走廊路由器旁边的卡片上。

lines.en: The heating is not coming on. Is there a switch?
lines.zh: 暖气不热。有开关吗？

lines.en: The thermostat is behind the living room door. Set it to twenty.
lines.zh: 温控器在客厅门后。调到二十度。

scenes.name: 景点买票 · 两人一学生
scenes.setting: 周末，景点门口排了二十分钟。

lines.en: Two adults, please. Is there a student rate?
lines.zh: 两张成人票。有学生票吗？

lines.en: There is, with a student card. Eight each instead of twelve.
lines.zh: 有，带学生证。八块，原价十二。

lines.en: I have mine, but not my friend.
lines.zh: 我有，我朋友没有。

lines.en: Then one adult and one student. Twenty pounds.
lines.zh: 那一个成人一个学生。二十镑。

lines.en: Does that include the exhibition upstairs?
lines.zh: 含楼上的展览吗？

lines.en: The permanent one, yes. The temporary one is extra.
lines.zh: 常设展含。特展另收。

lines.en: What time does it close?
lines.zh: 几点关门？

lines.en: Six, and last entry is half past five.
lines.zh: 六点，最后入场五点半。

branch.task: 售票员推销一个组合票，你要判断值不值

prompt.en: For four pounds more you can add the tower.
prompt.zh: 加四镑可以加塔楼。

say.en: Is the view better from the tower?
say.zh: 塔楼视野更好吗？

react.en: It is the only place you see the whole city.
react.zh: 那是唯一能看全城的地方。

say.en: Not today. We are short of time.
say.zh: 今天不了。我们时间不够。

react.en: Then just the museum ticket.

phrases.en: Last entry is half past five.

scenes.name: 跟一日游 · 城堡停九十分钟
scenes.setting: 你报了个一日游，行程很满。

lines.en: Everyone on the bus? We leave in two minutes.
lines.zh: 都上车了吗？两分钟后出发。

lines.en: Excuse me, how long do we stay at the castle?
lines.zh: 请问城堡停多久？

lines.en: Ninety minutes. Meet back at this spot at two.
lines.zh: 九十分钟。两点回这儿集合。

lines.en: Is the ticket included or do we pay there?
lines.zh: 门票含还是现场买？

lines.en: Included. Show the sticker on your jacket.
lines.zh: 含。把外套上的贴纸给他们看。

lines.en: What if I want to skip the castle and walk in the village?
lines.zh: 如果我不进城堡，在村里走走呢？

lines.en: That is fine. Just be back at the bus at two.
lines.zh: 可以。两点回车上就行。

branch.task: 行程临时变了，你要决定跟不跟

prompt.en: The castle is closed for a private event. We will swap it for the abbey.
prompt.zh: 城堡因私人活动关闭。改成修道院。

say.en: The abbey is fine, I came for the old town anyway.
say.zh: 修道院也行，我本来就想看老城。

react.en: Then nobody loses. We leave in five.
react.zh: 那谁都不亏。五分钟后走。

say.en: I paid for the castle. Can I get a partial refund?
say.zh: 我付的是城堡的钱。能部分退款吗？

react.en: Ask at the office tonight, they will sort it.
react.zh: 今晚去办公室问，他们会处理。

phrases.en: How long do we stay here?
Meet back at this spot at two.

scenes.name: 求职面试 · 前端第三轮
scenes.setting: 你面试一家做产品的公司，岗位是前端工程师，聊到第三轮。

lines.en: Thanks for coming in. Tell me a little about yourself.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来。简单介绍一下自己吧。

lines.en: I've been working as a front-end developer for three years, mostly on internal tools.
lines.zh: 我做前端开发三年了，主要做内部工具。
lines.note: 「做了三年」用 I've been working，不用 I work，否则听起来像一直在同一状态。

lines.en: What made you want to apply here?
lines.zh: 为什么想来我们这儿？

lines.en: I've followed your product for a while, and I'd like to work on something more user-facing.
lines.zh: 我关注你们产品有一阵了，想做一些更贴近用户的东西。

lines.en: What would you say is your biggest weakness?
lines.zh: 你觉得你最大的不足是什么？

lines.en: I tend to take on too much on my own. I've started asking for help earlier, but it's still a work in progress.
lines.zh: 我容易一个人扛太多。现在会早点开口求助，但还在改。
lines.note: a work in progress＝还在改进中。谈缺点时的体面收尾，不等于是借口。

lines.en: And how do you handle tight deadlines?
lines.zh: 遇到很紧的截止日期怎么处理？

lines.en: I break the work down and flag risks early, rather than hoping it'll be fine.
lines.zh: 我会把活拆开、尽早把风险讲出来，而不是指望最后没事。

lines.en: Good. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 好。你有什么想问我们的吗？

lines.en: Yes, what does success look like in this role in the first six months?
lines.zh: 有，这个岗位头半年做到什么样算成功？
lines.note: 反问环节最加分的一句：What does success look like…

branch.task: 对方说你的回答太笼统，要给一个具体例子

prompt.en: That's a bit vague. Could you give me an example?
prompt.zh: 这有点笼统。能举个例子吗？

say.en: Sure. Last quarter I took on two projects and missed a deadline.
say.zh: 好。上季度我同时接了两个项目，结果误了一个期限。

react.en: Thanks for being specific. And how do you handle tight deadlines?
react.zh: 谢谢，很具体。那你怎么应对很紧的期限？

say.en: Honestly, that's the hardest question. Let me think for a second.
say.zh: 说实话这个最难答，让我想一下。

react.en: No problem. Whenever you're ready. And how do you handle tight deadlines?
react.zh: 没关系，想好了再说。那你怎么应对很紧的期限？

scenes.setting: 你十天前订的显示器还没到，物流页面停在上周四。你打了客服。

lines.en: Thank you for calling. How may I assist you today?
lines.zh: 感谢来电，请问有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi, I ordered a monitor ten days ago and it still hasn't arrived.
lines.zh: 你好，我十天前订了一台显示器，到现在还没到。

lines.en: It's 88214. The tracking page hasn't updated since last Thursday.

scenes.name: 项目会议改期 · 上线日期要延
scenes.setting: 上线前两周，测试报告显示还有一批严重缺陷没修。

lines.en: Shall we start? We have forty minutes.
lines.zh: 开始吧？我们有四十分钟。

lines.en: Before we begin, can everyone see the agenda?
lines.zh: 开始前，大家能看到议程吗？

lines.en: It is on the screen. Item one is the launch date.
lines.zh: 在屏幕上。第一项是上线日期。

lines.en: I have a concern about the date. QA needs another week.
lines.zh: 日期我有顾虑。测试还需要一周。

lines.en: That pushes us past the campaign. Can we cut scope?
lines.zh: 那就赶不上活动了。能砍范围吗？

lines.en: We could ship the core and leave reporting for later.
lines.zh: 可以先上核心功能，报表往后放。

lines.en: All right. Who owns the new timeline?
lines.zh: 行。谁负责新的时间表？

lines.en: I will send it by tomorrow and flag the risks.
lines.zh: 我明天发出来，并标出风险。

lines.en: Good. Anything else before we close?
lines.zh: 好。结束前还有别的吗？

lines.en: Just one thing. Let us keep the notes in one place.
lines.zh: 就一件。会议记录放同一个地方。

branch.task: 对方质疑你的判断，你要拿出依据

prompt.en: QA always says they need another week. Is it really that bad?

say.zh: 结账流程有两个崩溃 bug。这不是打磨问题。

react.en: All right, show me the list after this.

say.en: We can ship behind a flag and turn it on later.
say.zh: 可以先带开关上线，之后再打开。

react.en: That I can sell to the client.

phrases.en: I have a concern about the date.

lines.en: Can you hear me now?
lines.zh: 现在能听见吗？

lines.en: Sharing now. Can you see it?

lines.en: I can. The third slide is blank on my side.

scenes.name: 接客户投诉 · 报告迟到
scenes.setting: 客户在电话里语气很硬，董事会要用这份报告。

lines.en: We have been waiting three weeks for the report.
lines.zh: 那份报告我们等了三周。

lines.en: I understand, and I am sorry. Let me tell you where it stands.
lines.zh: 我理解，也很抱歉。我说一下现在的情况。

lines.en: Where it stands is that my board meeting is on Monday.
lines.zh: 现在的情况是，我周一的董事会。

lines.en: You will have it Friday. I will send a draft Thursday for your comments.
lines.zh: 周五会给您。周四我先发一版草稿给您好提意见。

lines.en: Friday is cutting it close. Why was it late?
lines.zh: 周五太紧了。为什么会晚？

lines.en: Two of the numbers came in late from your finance team.
lines.zh: 有两个数字你们财务给晚了。

lines.en: Nobody told me that.
lines.zh: 没人告诉我这件事。

lines.en: That is on us. I should have flagged it two weeks ago.
lines.zh: 这是我们的问题。我两周前就该提出来。

lines.en: All right. Friday, and I want the draft Thursday.
lines.zh: 行。周五，还有周四要看到草稿。

branch.task: 客户逼你给一个承诺，你要给得既确定又留余地

prompt.en: Can you promise it will be on my desk Friday morning?
prompt.zh: 你能保证周五上午放到我桌上吗？

say.en: By noon Friday, and I will confirm Thursday night.
say.zh: 周五中午前，周四晚上我跟您确认。

react.en: Noon Friday. I will hold you to that.

say.en: I can promise Thursday night, not Friday morning.
say.zh: 我能保证周四晚上，不是周五上午。

react.en: Then Thursday night it is.

phrases.en: Let me tell you where it stands.
I should have flagged it earlier.

scenes.name: 跟主管谈加薪 · 范围变大薪资没变
scenes.setting: 你接手了离职同事的全部工作，半年没有调薪。

lines.en: Do you have twenty minutes? I would like to talk about my role.
lines.zh: 你有二十分钟吗？我想聊聊我的岗位。

lines.en: Sure, sit down. What is on your mind?
lines.zh: 当然，坐。什么事？

lines.en: I have taken on the billing service and two new clients this year.
lines.zh: 今年我接了计费服务，还带了两个新客户。

lines.en: You have. The team is smaller than it was.
lines.zh: 是的。团队比之前小了。

lines.en: My scope has grown, but my title and pay have not changed.
lines.zh: 我的范围扩大了，但职级和薪资没变。

lines.en: What are you asking for?
lines.zh: 你想要什么？

lines.en: A review of my band, and a title that matches the work.
lines.zh: 重新评估我的职级带宽，还有匹配工作的头衔。
lines.note: band 是薪资带宽，谈薪时说 band 比说 money 专业。

lines.en: I cannot promise a number today. Can I come back to you next week?
lines.zh: 我今天给不了具体数字。下周回复你可以吗？

lines.en: That is fair. I will send you the list of what I have taken on.
lines.zh: 可以。我把接手的事情列一份发你。

branch.task: 对方要你把要求量化，你要给出可比较的依据

prompt.en: Give me a number. What do you think you should be on?
prompt.zh: 给我个数。你觉得应该是多少？

say.en: The market range for this scope is ten to fifteen percent above mine.
say.zh: 这个范围的市场价比我高百分之十到十五。

react.en: Let me check that against our bands.
react.zh: 我拿这个跟我们的带宽对一下。

say.en: I would rather hear your range first.
say.zh: 我更想先听你们的范围。

react.en: Fair enough. I will bring it next week.

phrases.en: My scope has grown, but my pay has not.
phrases.zh: 我的范围扩大了，薪资没变。

phrases.en: What would make it a yes in six months?
phrases.zh: 半年后做到什么才能批？

lines.zh: 当然，坐。什么事？

lines.en: I have taken on the billing service and two new clients this year.
lines.zh: 今年我接了计费服务，还带了两个新客户。

lines.en: You have. The team is smaller than it was.
lines.zh: 是的。团队比之前小了。

lines.en: My scope has grown, but my title and pay have not changed.
lines.zh: 我的范围扩大了，但职级和薪资没变。

lines.en: What are you asking for?
lines.zh: 你想要什么？

lines.en: I have an offer at fifteen percent more. I would rather stay.
lines.zh: 我有个高百分之十五的 offer。但我更想留下。
lines.note: band 是薪资带宽，谈薪时说 band 比说 money 专业。

lines.en: I cannot promise a number today. Can I come back to you next week?
lines.zh: 我今天给不了具体数字。下周回复你可以吗？

lines.en: That is fair. I will send you the list of what I have taken on.
lines.zh: 可以。我把接手的事情列一份发你。

say.en: I would rather hear your range first.

react.en: Fair enough. I will bring it next week.

scenes.name: 入职第一天 · 第一天到办公室
scenes.setting: 你换了新公司，第一天提前二十分钟到。

lines.en: Welcome. Let me show you around the floor.
lines.zh: 欢迎。我带你转一圈。

lines.en: Thanks. Where should I sit?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我坐哪儿？

lines.en: By the window, next to Sam. He will set up your laptop.
lines.zh: 窗边，Sam 旁边。他帮你配电脑。

lines.en: Do I need to do any paperwork today?
lines.zh: 今天要办什么手续吗？

lines.en: HR will email you. Bank details and next of kin.
lines.zh: 人事会给你发邮件。银行信息和紧急联系人。

lines.en: Who do I ask if I get stuck?
lines.zh: 卡住了问谁？

lines.en: Sam for anything technical, me for anything else.
lines.zh: 技术问题找 Sam，其它找我。

lines.en: Got it. Is there a standup I should join today?
lines.zh: 明白。今天有站会我要参加吗？

branch.task: 主管问你的预期，你要说得具体

prompt.en: What do you want to be doing in six months?
prompt.zh: 你半年后想做到什么程度？

say.en: Owning one service end to end, without help.
say.zh: 独立负责一个服务，不用人帮。

react.en: That is a clear goal. We can plan around it.
react.zh: 目标很清楚。可以围着它排。

say.en: I would rather find out first, then decide.
say.zh: 我想先看看，再定。

react.en: Fair. Ask me again in a month.

phrases.en: Who do I ask if I get stuck?
What does a normal week look like?

scenes.name: 和同事意见冲突 · 该不该这周上线
scenes.setting: 上线前一天的评审会，两个人意见相反。

lines.en: I do not think we should ship this week.
lines.zh: 我觉得这周不该上线。

lines.en: Why not? QA signed off yesterday.
lines.zh: 为什么？测试昨天签了。

lines.en: They signed off the old build. The fix went in after.
lines.zh: 他们签的是旧构建。修复是之后才进去的。

lines.en: Then we ship the old build and patch on Monday.
lines.zh: 那就发旧构建，周一打补丁。

lines.en: That is two releases in three days. Support will hate it.
lines.zh: 三天两个版本。客服会疯。

lines.en: What would you do instead?
lines.zh: 那你想怎么办？

lines.en: Wait until Thursday and ship once.
lines.zh: 等到周四，一次发完。

lines.en: Fine by me, but I want that in writing to the client.
lines.zh: 我没问题，但你要写下来发给客户。

branch.task: 同事把球踢回给你，你要给出可执行的方案

prompt.en: What would you do instead?
prompt.zh: 那你想怎么办？

say.en: Ship behind a flag, turn it on Tuesday.
say.zh: 带开关上线，周二再打开。

react.en: That works. Support gets one release.
react.zh: 这个行。客服只面对一个版本。

say.en: Let us ask the client which risk they prefer.
say.zh: 问客户他们更愿意承担哪个风险。

react.en: I would rather decide ourselves.

scenes.name: 和供应商谈价 · 订单翻倍要折扣
scenes.setting: 你们把采购量翻了一倍，想重新谈价。

lines.en: Our price is fixed for this year.
lines.zh: 我们的价格今年是固定的。

lines.en: We doubled the order. That should move the price.
lines.zh: 我们的订单翻倍了。价格应该能动。

lines.en: How much are we talking about?
lines.zh: 你想谈多少？

lines.en: Ten percent, and net sixty instead of thirty.
lines.zh: 十个点，账期从三十天改六十天。

lines.en: Ten is too much. I can do six and net forty-five.
lines.zh: 十太多。六，账期四十五天。

lines.en: Seven and net sixty, and we sign for two years.
lines.zh: 七，账期六十天，我们签两年。

lines.en: Seven and net fifty. That is my final offer.
lines.zh: 七，账期五十天。这是我的底线。

lines.en: Agreed. Send the contract and we will sign this week.
lines.zh: 成交。把合同发来，这周签。

branch.task: 对方给了一个还价，你要判断还能不能推

prompt.en: Seven percent is already below our margin for this volume.
prompt.zh: 这个量下七个点已经低于我们的利润线。

say.en: Then take it out of the packaging cost instead.

react.en: We can switch to a simpler box. That is another two.

say.en: Seven and net sixty, and we announce it as a partnership.

react.en: The announcement is worth something. Done.

phrases.zh: 账期从三十天改六十天。

scenes.setting: 月度一对一，你准备了三件事要说。

lines.en: How are things? Anything on your mind?
lines.zh: 怎么样？有什么想聊的？

lines.en: I am stretched. Three projects, and I am the only one who knows the billing code.
lines.zh: 我有点撑不住。三个项目，而且只有我一个人懂计费那块代码。

lines.en: That is a bus factor of one. Let us fix it.
lines.zh: 那是一个人扛一个系统。得解决。

lines.en: I could pair with Tom for a week.
lines.zh: 我可以跟 Tom 结对一周。

lines.en: Do that. Drop the reporting project until then.
lines.zh: 那就这么办。报表项目先放一放。

lines.en: Will the client accept a delay?
lines.zh: 客户能接受延期吗？

lines.en: I will tell them myself.
lines.zh: 我去跟他们说。

lines.en: Then that unblocks me. Thanks.
lines.zh: 那我就松口气了。谢谢。

say.en: Write the runbook first, then hand over.

react.en: Good. Two weeks, and I will check in.

scenes.name: 提离职 · 去另一家公司
scenes.setting: 你拿到 offer，决定走。

lines.en: I have decided to move on. Here is my notice.
lines.zh: 我决定走了。这是我的辞职信。

lines.en: I am sorry to hear it. Where are you going?
lines.zh: 很遗憾。去哪儿？

lines.en: A smaller team, closer to home. Nothing personal.
lines.zh: 一个更小的团队，离家近。跟公司无关。

lines.en: When is your last day?
lines.zh: 最后一天是哪天？

lines.en: Four weeks from Friday, as my contract says.
lines.zh: 按合同，周五起四周后。

lines.en: Can we keep you for the handover?
lines.zh: 交接能多留一段吗？

lines.en: I will write the runbook and do two weeks of pairing.
lines.zh: 我会写操作手册，再结对两周。

lines.en: Then let us plan the transition this week.
lines.zh: 那这周把过渡计划定下来。

react.en: Then I will make the handover as easy as I can.

react.en: Fair. Let us talk on Monday anyway.
